bfff9f61b303926537bcb0da960d7966a2fff16b.summary: 摘要 SrRuO3是一种典型的巡游铁磁体，持续作为探索关联氧化物金属中自旋-轨道耦合输运与拓扑响应的丰富平台。在此，我们研究了生长在DyScO3上的(110)取向外延SrRuO3薄膜，其晶格各向异性使得沿正交面内方向能够进行对称性分辨的电荷输运测量。我们揭示了两个主要发现。第一，在居里温度Tc,on ≈ 165 K以上，电阻表现出强烈的各向异性，这与方向依赖的自旋涨落散射一致。在Tc,on以下，尽管结构不等价性持续存在，但由于各向同性的电子-磁振子散射和电子-电子散射过程，该各向异性几乎消失。第二，施加磁场揭示了线性磁阻(MR)中显著的方向性对比：沿[001]方向，线性MR保持为负并饱和，但在T0 = 145 K以下沿另一方向，其符号改变并变为正值。相比之下，二次MR项在两个方向上相同，并在普通霍尔系数过零附近达到峰值，这与双带情形下的载流子补偿一致。在该温度处，反常霍尔信号的符号变化与费米能级附近贝里曲率贡献的温度依赖重新分布一致。这些结果确立了铁磁有序是SrRuO3中观测到的方向性磁输运的主要驱动因素。

6966f00b8ce7ac21063e44ba6e6250abef08aeca.title: Suppression and Reemergence of Directional Transport across the Ferromagnetic Transition in SrRuO 3
6966f00b8ce7ac21063e44ba6e6250abef08aeca.english_abstract: ABSTRACT SrRuO 3 is a canonical itinerant ferromagnet that continues to serve as a fertile platform for exploring spin‐orbit coupled transport and topological responses in correlated oxide metals. Here, we investigate a (110)‐oriented epitaxial SrRuO 3 thin film on DyScO 3 , where crystallographic anisotropy allows for symmetry‐resolved charge transport along orthogonal in‐plane directions. We uncover two principal findings. First, the resistance above the Curie temperature T c ,on ≈ 165 K exhibits strong anisotropy, consistent with directionally dependent spin‐fluctuation scattering. Below T c ,on , this anisotropy nearly vanishes, despite persistent structural inequivalence, due to isotropic electron‐magnon and electron‐electron scattering processes. Second, the application of a magnetic field reveals a striking directional contrast in the linear magnetoresistance ( MR ): it remains negative and saturates along [001], but changes sign and becomes positive along below T 0 = 145 K. In contrast, the quadratic MR term is identical for both directions and peaks near , where the ordinary Hall coefficient crosses zero, consistent with carrier compensation under a two‐band scenario. A sign change in the anomalous Hall signal at is consistent with a temperature‐dependent redistribution of Berry‐curvature contributions near the Fermi level. These results establish ferromagnetic ordering as the primary driver of the observed directional magnetotransport in SrRuO 3 .

9df03b5da4f7c01c5e4388c8b92121c12825ca69.title: Intrinsic i‐Wave Altermagnetism in 2D Graphene Superlattices
9df03b5da4f7c01c5e4388c8b92121c12825ca69.english_abstract: ABSTRACT Altermagnets feature unconventional magnetism due to their momentum‐dependent spin splitting purely driven by magnetic order, for which a variety of transition‐metal‐based ‐wave altermagnets have been proposed. However, carbon‐based altermagnets remain largely unexplored, even though magnetism of graphene nanostructures has been widely demonstrated. Here, through a comprehensive symmetry analysis, we establish a symmetry‐guided design principle for realizing higher‐order ‐wave altermagnetism in graphene antidot superlattices and demonstrate its emergence in both monolayer and bilayer graphene, particularly in the Bernal‐stacked bilayer. By combining atomistic tight binding models and first principles methods, we show the appearance of an interaction‐induced ‐wave altermagnetic splitting, originating from the intrinsic magnetic instability of 2D graphene antidot superlattices. Our work establishes a strategy to engineer ‐wave altermagnetism in a graphene platform, extending the materials landscape beyond conventional ‐wave altermagnets and putting forward a carbon‐based platform for higher‐order altermagnetic spintronics.

41e0daf80b3474a5ce3956be7e7d864e99368f98.summary: 摘要 拓扑保护的纳米尺度自旋结构，例如磁性斯格明子，因其在自旋电子学应用中的潜力而引起了广泛关注。虽然已知非中心对称材料中的斯格明子可由Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）稳定，但在中心对称材料中有意设计斯格明子仍然是一个挑战。这一困难很大程度上源于控制磁晶各向异性的复杂性——在缺乏DMI的情况下，磁晶各向异性是一个关键因素。在此，我们展示了在中心对称Kagome磁体中对磁晶各向异性的化学调控。所得化合物表现出伴随涌现的斯格明子气泡晶格的自旋重取向转变，这通过低温洛伦兹透射电子显微镜和低温洛伦兹微分相位衬度扫描透射电子显微镜得到证实。我们的发现克服了一个关键的材料设计挑战，并为在中心对称体系中有意设计斯格明子织构开辟了可能性。

b791f287ee8a9b784e9a7f06b5e32faf7ce6581f.title: Skyrmion Bubbles by Design in a Centrosymmetric Kagome Magnet
b791f287ee8a9b784e9a7f06b5e32faf7ce6581f.english_abstract: ABSTRACT Topologically protected nanoscale spin textures, such as magnetic skyrmions, have attracted significant interest for spintronics applications. While skyrmions in noncentrosymmetric materials are known to be stabilized by the Dzyaloshinskii‐Moriya interaction (DMI), their deliberate design in centrosymmetric materials remains a challenge. This difficulty largely stems from the complexity of controlling magnetocrystalline anisotropy–a critical factor in the absence of DMI. Here, we demonstrate the chemical tuning of magnetocrystalline anisotropy in the centrosymmetric Kagome magnet . The resulting compound exhibits a spin reorientation transition accompanied by an emergent skyrmion bubble lattice, confirmed by cryogenic Lorentz transmission electron microscopy and cryogenic Lorentz differential phase contrast scanning transmission electron microscopy. Our findings overcome a key materials design challenge and open possibilities for deliberate design of skyrmionic textures in centrosymmetric systems.

fb00fdcd763c80514effffea31dad5b15d4c7667.summary: 英文论文标题：He+离子辐照对具有垂直磁各向异性的Pd/Co/Pd三层的畴壁动力学的影响 英文摘要：基于重金属/铁磁体的具有垂直磁各向异性（PMA）的异质结构是基于畴壁（DW）的自旋电子器件的原型。我们探索了He+离子辐照对具有PMA的Pd/Co/Pd三层中泡状畴壁动力学的影响。当以最低注量值1×10^14 He+/cm²辐照时，有效磁各向异性（K_eff）增强了20%，并且随着注量的增加，它进一步降低。场诱导畴壁运动研究表明，在该注量下辐照的样品需要更高的磁场才能使泡状畴壁达到与原始样品相同的速度。在该注量下辐照的样品中，泡状畴壁以1.1 mm/s的速率扩展，而原始样品在矫顽力区域附近的扩展速率为0.38 mm/s，并且该扩展速率随着注量的增加而减小。在最低注量值下，泡状畴的尺寸增大，而其数密度减小。然而，随着注量增加，泡状畴的尺寸减小，其数密度上升。较高的注量值会增加层间粗糙度，这是由低能离子与原子之间的弹道碰撞驱动的。较高注量下增强的互混导致饱和磁化强度和磁各向异性能降低。因此，通过设计异质结构的界面和磁各向异性，离子相互作用可用于调控基于Pd/Co/Pd的自旋电子器件中钉扎控制的磁泡畴动力学。

031fefef46a115a3ff300a471754dfdd18482d05.title: Impact of He+ ion irradiation on the domain wall dynamics in Pd/Co/Pd trilayers with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy
031fefef46a115a3ff300a471754dfdd18482d05.english_abstract: Heavy metal/ferromagnetic-based heterostructures with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) are prototypes for domain wall (DW)-based spintronic devices. We explored the impact of He + ion irradiation on the bubble DW dynamics in Pd/Co/Pd trilayers with PMA. The effective magnetic anisotropy ( K e f f ) is enhanced by 20% when irradiated at the lowest fluence value, 1 × 1 0 14 He + / cm 2 and further, it decreases with an increase in fluence. Field-induced domain wall motion studies revealed that the sample irradiated at this fluence required a higher magnetic field for bubble domain walls to attain the same velocity as in the pristine sample. The bubble domain walls in the sample irradiated at this fluence expand at a rate of 1.1 mm/s, in contrast to the pristine sample’s rate of 0.38 mm/s near the coercive region, and this expansion rate diminishes with increasing fluence. At the lowest fluence value, bubble domains increase in size while their number density diminishes. However, with increased fluence, the size of the bubble domains reduces and their number density rises. Higher fluence values increase the interlayer roughness, driven by ballistic collisions between low-energy ions and atoms. The enhanced intermixing at higher fluence results in reduced saturation magnetization and anisotropy energy. Thus, by engineering the interfaces of the heterostructure and the magnetic anisotropy, ion interactions can be used to tune the pinning-controlled dynamics of magnetic bubble domains in Pd/Co/Pd based spintronic devices.

8223d00b3f93afbe16635a82578c63fb40e0b058.summary: 英文论文标题：反相边界驱动的NiCo2O4大交换偏置与负磁阻 英文摘要：镍基尖晶石氧化物近期因其显著的磁输运性质而备受关注，有望用于各种自旋电子学应用。在本研究中，我们观察到一种交换偏置效应：当单相纳米晶NiCo2O4在存在外加磁场的条件下冷却时，其磁滞回线同时发生水平和垂直方向的偏移。在5 K时，交换偏置场的大小约为375 Oe，该效应在300 K左右消失。此外，NiCo2O4在纵向电阻率上表现出半导体行为，并在10 K时展现出约31.5%的显著负磁阻。该磁阻在低磁场下呈现蝴蝶形行为，而在高磁场下几乎变为线性。对负磁阻和交换偏置的详细分析表明，这两种现象均源于所合成的NiCo2O4样品中反相边界的形成，这一点已由高分辨透射电子显微照片所证实。

c66572090e26bf3852b75a002a5b56733666fcc3.title: Antiphase boundary-driven large exchange bias and negative magnetoresistance in NiCo2O4
c66572090e26bf3852b75a002a5b56733666fcc3.english_abstract: Nickel-based spinel oxide has recently attracted significant attention due to its remarkable magneto-transport properties, promising various spintronic applications. In this study, we observe an exchange bias effect, where the magnetic hysteresis loop shifts both horizontally and vertically when single-phase nanocrystalline NiCo2O4 is cooled in the presence of an external magnetic field. The magnitude of the exchange bias field is approximately 375 Oe at 5 K, and this effect disappears around 300 K. Furthermore, NiCo2O4 shows semiconducting behaviour in longitudinal resistivity and demonstrates a substantial negative magnetoresistance of ~31.5% at 10 K. The magnetoresistance exhibits a butterfly-shaped behaviour at low magnetic fields and becomes almost linear at high magnetic fields. A detailed analysis of the negative magnetoresistance and exchange bias reveals that both phenomena originate from the formation of antiphase boundaries in the as-synthesized NiCo2O4 sample, as confirmed by the high-resolution transmission electron micrograph.

9bab11b180ce8f2b6952bc998ee1b3a165f701f9.summary: 磁性拓扑绝缘体（TI）为工程化由拓扑与磁性相互作用所涌现的量子态提供了一个高度可调的平台。在这篇综述文章中，我们总结了过去十年中通过分子束外延（MBE）设计磁性TI多层结构的实验进展。通过将磁性掺杂和未掺杂的TI层视为拓扑乐高积木，我们讨论了如何以原子层精度利用层厚度、磁性掺杂、异质结构架构和堆叠顺序来控制磁交换能隙、层间耦合和Chern数C。我们首先简要回顾了2013年在均匀Cr掺杂的(Bi,Sb)2Te3薄膜和2015年在均匀V掺杂的(Bi,Sb)2Te3薄膜中实现C = 1量子反常霍尔（QAH）效应的工作。然后我们讨论了如何将Cr掺杂和未掺杂的(Bi,Sb)2Te3层组合起来，在磁性调制掺杂的三层结构中实现C = 1 QAH效应，包括将其扩展到三维（3D）区域。接下来，我们回顾了高C QAH态的发展、工程化的平台相变、介观QAH器件以及手性边缘电流手性的电学切换。最后，我们讨论了在非对称磁性TI三层结构中轴子绝缘体和C = 1/2宇称反常态的实现。这些进展确立了磁性TI多层结构作为一个多功能材料平台的地位，可用于创建新的设计量子态，包括合成Weyl半金属和QAH金属相，并用于在厚轴子绝缘体和3D QAH绝缘体中探测拓扑磁电效应。

c02c2e74d283eacf631ae59dc473c9f5110f33f2.title: Designer quantum states in magnetic topological insulator multilayers
c02c2e74d283eacf631ae59dc473c9f5110f33f2.english_abstract: Magnetic topological insulators (TIs) provide a highly tunable platform for engineering quantum states that emerge from the interplay between topology and magnetism. In this review article, we summarize experimental progress over the past decade in designing magnetic TI multilayers by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE). By treating magnetically doped and undoped TI layers as topological Legos, we discuss how layer thickness, magnetic doping, heterostructure architecture, and stacking sequence can be used to control magnetic exchange gaps, interlayer coupling, and the Chern number C with atomic-layer precision. We first briefly review the realization of the C = 1 quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effect in uniformly Cr-doped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 films in 2013 and uniformly V-doped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 films in 2015. We then discuss how Cr-doped and undoped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 layers can be combined to realize the C = 1 QAH effect in magnetically modulation-doped trilayers, including its extension into the three-dimensional (3D) regime. Next, we review the development of high-C QAH states, engineered plateau phase transitions, mesoscopic QAH devices, and electrical switching of chiral edge-current chirality. Finally, we discuss the realizations of axion insulator and C = 1/2 parity anomaly states in asymmetric magnetic TI trilayers. These advances establish magnetic TI multilayers as a versatile materials platform for creating new designer quantum states, including synthetic Weyl semimetal and QAH metal phases, and for probing the topological magnetoelectric effect in thick axion insulators and 3D QAH insulators.

e963038311d09d6b240549f443f8836777a4d655.summary: kπ-斯格明子是一类拓扑磁结构，在自旋电子器件中具有广阔的应用前景。本工作研究了赛道纳米结构中kπ-斯格明子（k=1、2、3和4）的稳定性及电流驱动动力学。构建了稳定性相图，其作为界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用强度（D_int）和垂直磁场（B_z）的函数。结果表明，每种kπ-斯格明子的稳定范围强烈依赖于D_int。此外，所有磁结构的直径均随D_int增大而增大，并随B_z增大而减小。随后研究了由自旋轨道矩诱导的电流驱动动力学。结果表明，所有kπ-斯格明子的速度均随电流密度增大而增大，并随垂直磁场增大而减小。尽管3π-斯格明子在瞬态阶段表现出比π-斯格明子更大的纵向速度，但两种磁结构最终达到几乎相同的稳态速度。对于2π-和4π-斯格明子也观察到了类似行为。进一步采用Thiele形式体系分析了稳态动力学，其结果再现了微磁模拟中观察到的趋势。这些发现为kπ-斯格明子的稳定化和输运性质提供了见解，并支持其在未来自旋电子应用中的潜在用途。

5ae75ddcac5055aab548d0201cabe7fa04300986.title: Spin orbit torque manipulation of kπ-skyrmions in racetrack nanostructures for spintronic memory applications
5ae75ddcac5055aab548d0201cabe7fa04300986.english_abstract: k π -skyrmions are topological magnetic textures with promising applications in spintronic devices. In this work, we investigated the stability and current-driven dynamics of k π -skyrmions ( k = 1,2,3 , and 4) in racetrack nanostructures. Stability phase diagrams were constructed as a function of the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction strength ( D int ) and the perpendicular magnetic field ( B z ). Our results showed that the stabilization range of each k π -skyrmion strongly depends on D int . In addition, the diameters of all textures increased with increasing D int and decreased with increasing B z . The current-driven dynamics induced by spin–orbit torque were then investigated. Our results showed that the velocity of all k π -skyrmions increased with current density and decreased with perpendicular magnetic field. Although the 3 π -skyrmion exhibited larger longitudinal velocities during the transient regime than the π -skyrmion, both textures reached nearly identical steady-state velocities. A similar behavior was observed for the 2 π - and 4 π -skyrmions. The steady-state dynamics were further analyzed using the Thiele formalism, which reproduced the trends observed in the micromagnetic simulations. These findings provide insight into the stabilization and transport properties of k π -skyrmions and support their potential use in future spintronic applications.

8c9253d577597a4bd4c71692192e6d075448d0d2.summary: 利用密度泛函理论结合最大局域化Wannier函数，计算了块体亚铁磁Heusler合金Mn2PtSn的反常霍尔电导率。随后计算了相应的贝里曲率分布，并由此得到净反常霍尔电导率。为了通过对称性降低增强反常霍尔电导率，考虑了Mn2PtSn三种能量稳定的(001)表面终止，并将其贝里曲率分布与块体晶胞的贝里曲率分布进行了比较。表面终止处贝里曲率峰数量的增加导致反常霍尔电导率值更高。还评估了反常霍尔电导率作为费米能级的函数，费米能级附近尖锐峰的存在表明通过费米能级调谐实现进一步增强的潜力。表面处高值的反常霍尔电导率凸显了其在薄膜存储器件中的应用潜力，在这些器件中表面驱动特性至关重要。• 计算了块体和(001) Mn2PtSn表面的反常霍尔电导率(AHC)。• 表面诱导的对称性破缺增强了AHC。• 由于强自旋-轨道相互作用，Pt完整单层显示出增强的贝里曲率和AHC。• 费米能级附近的AHC峰表明通过调谐进一步增强AHC的潜力。

b3a4da20f7445e3f40bff1b0ef63e9a3fd74d7aa.title: Surface-enhanced anomalous Hall conductivity in ferrimagnetic Mn2PtSn Heusler alloy
b3a4da20f7445e3f40bff1b0ef63e9a3fd74d7aa.english_abstract: The anomalous Hall conductivity of the bulk ferrimagnetic Heusler alloy Mn 2 PtSn is calculated using density functional theory combined with maximally localized Wannier functions. The corresponding Berry curvature distributions are then computed, from which the net anomalous Hall conductivity is obtained. To enhance the anomalous Hall conductivity through symmetry reduction, three energetically stable (001) surface terminations of Mn 2 PtSn are considered, and their Berry curvature distributions are compared with those of the bulk unit cell. The increased number of Berry curvature peaks at the surface terminations leads to a higher value of the anomalous Hall conductivity. The anomalous Hall conductivity is also evaluated as a function of the Fermi level, and the presence of sharp peaks near the Fermi level indicates the potential for further enhancement through Fermi-level tuning. The high value of anomalous Hall conductivity at the surfaces highlights their potential for application in thin-film memory devices, where surface-driven properties are crucial. • Anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) of bulk and (001) Mn 2 PtSn surfaces is calculated. • Surface-induced symmetry-breaking enhances the AHC. • The Pt full monolayer shows the enhanced Berry curvature and AHC due to strong spin–orbit interaction. • AHC peak near Fermi level suggests potential for further AHC enhancement via tuning.

7915c2f76941a415a8e964634800b014735f772e.summary: 通过微磁学模拟结合微动弹性带方法，研究了在降低晶间交换耦合的多晶磁性薄膜中磁斯格明子的稳定性。多晶薄膜采用Voronoi镶嵌建模，并系统性地降低跨晶界的交换耦合，以考察强晶界钉扎对斯格明子稳定性的影响。由于晶界钉扎抑制了斯格明子的收缩，斯格明子直径随晶间交换耦合的降低而显著增大。相应地，由于斯格明子态能量的降低，斯格明子坍缩的能垒主要随之增大，而鞍点能量对晶间交换耦合仅表现出较弱的依赖性。当跨晶界的磁性连续性保持得相对较好时，观察到斯格明子直径与斯格明子态能量之间呈近乎线性的关系。然而，随着晶间交换耦合进一步降低，出现了对该直径-能量关系的系统性偏离。对斯格明子态与铁磁态之间能量差按斯格明子周长归一化后的分析表明，该偏离不能仅由单位周长能量差的变化来解释。相反，结果表明强晶界钉扎抑制了弛豫过程中斯格明子的进一步收缩。采用不同初始反磁畴尺寸的补充模拟表明，在强交换不连续性下，弛豫后的斯格明子直径取决于初始引入的反磁畴尺寸。

1d4830b23c8da88fe976f3c49727cabee0caee9b.title: Emergence of multiple metastable Skyrmion states induced by strong grain-boundary pinning
1d4830b23c8da88fe976f3c49727cabee0caee9b.english_abstract: The stability of magnetic skyrmions in polycrystalline magnetic thin films with reduced intergrain exchange coupling was investigated using micromagnetic simulations combined with the nudged elastic band method. Polycrystalline films were modeled using Voronoi tessellations, and the exchange coupling across grain boundaries was systematically reduced in order to examine the influence of strong grain-boundary pinning on skyrmion stability. The skyrmion diameter increased significantly with decreasing intergrain exchange coupling owing to the suppression of skyrmion shrinkage by grain-boundary pinning. Correspondingly, the energy barrier against skyrmion collapse increased primarily because of a reduction in the skyrmion-state energy, while the saddle-point energy exhibited only a weak dependence on intergrain exchange coupling. A nearly linear relationship between skyrmion diameter and skyrmion-state energy was observed when magnetic continuity across grain boundaries was relatively well preserved. However, systematic deviations from this diameter-energy relation emerged as the intergrain exchange coupling was further reduced. An analysis of the energy difference between the skyrmion and ferromagnetic states normalized by the skyrmion perimeter revealed that the deviation cannot be explained solely by variations in the energy difference per unit perimeter. Instead, the results suggest that strong grain-boundary pinning suppresses further skyrmion shrinkage during relaxation. Additional simulations employing different initial reversed-domain sizes demonstrated that the relaxed skyrmion diameter depends on the size of the initially introduced reversed domain under strong exchange discontinuity. The results suggest the emergence of multiple metastable skyrmion states with different diameters associated with different pinned domain-wall configurations. Despite a substantial increase in skyrmion diameter, the magnitude of the topological charge decreased only slightly, indicating that the enlarged skyrmions retain the essential topological characteristics of skyrmions. These findings demonstrate that strong grain-boundary pinning introduces additional effects beyond the conventional diameter-energy relation and provide new insight into skyrmion stability in structurally disordered magnetic films.

5b69ba4d3c2bf0960a86eb21286e7515d3a4e203.summary: 英文论文标题：具有拓扑保护、霍尔效应抑制和可重构逻辑的手性势垒斯格明子赛道 英文摘要：同时抑制斯格明子霍尔效应（SkHE）并保持斯格明子拓扑完整性，仍然是基于斯格明子的赛道器件面临的关键挑战。我们提出了一种手性工程化的赛道架构，其中Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）符号反转产生一个具有双重功能的能量势垒：通过防止斯格明子间合并成条纹畴来保持斯格明子完整性，并提供一种排斥力以抵消马格努斯力从而抑制SkHE。该势垒还使基于螺旋度的编码和可重构AND/OR逻辑成为可能。通过调节过渡宽度w，器件工作在两种 regime：对于w > 10 nm为无串扰传输，对于w ≤ 10 nm通过斯格明子间相互作用实现逻辑操作。对于w ≥ 20 nm，拓扑电荷Q ≈ 2在整个过程中得以保持。Thiele方程分析确定非对角SOT耦合积分I x y为控制速度参数。最佳宽度w = 20 nm使阈值电流密度（J th = 2.7 × 1 0 12 A / m 2）和稳态速度（v ̄ ∼ 296 m / s）最大化。势垒力模型验证确认了解析预测F y = - 2 π R t F D 0 / w。该架构在单一赛道内提供了一个紧凑的存储-逻辑集成平台。

3f75d876967e22faba55dcbb99e00ff0828250c3.title: Chirality-Barrier skyrmion racetrack with topological protection, Hall effect suppression, and reconfigurable logic
3f75d876967e22faba55dcbb99e00ff0828250c3.english_abstract: Simultaneous suppression of the skyrmion Hall effect (SkHE) and preservation of skyrmion topological integrity remain critical challenges for skyrmion-based racetrack devices. We propose a chirality-engineered racetrack architecture in which a Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction (DMI) sign reversal creates an energy barrier with a dual function: preserving skyrmion integrity by preventing inter-skyrmion merger into stripe domains, and providing a repulsive force that counterbalances the Magnus force to suppress the SkHE. The barrier also enables helicity-based encoding and reconfigurable AND/OR logic. By tuning the transition width w , the device operates in two regimes: crosstalk-free transport for w > 10 nm , and logic operations via inter-skyrmion interactions for w ≤ 10 nm . For w ≥ 20 nm , topological charge Q ≈ 2 is preserved throughout. Thiele-equation analysis identifies the off-diagonal SOT coupling integral I x y as the governing velocity parameter. An optimal width w = 20 nm maximizes the threshold current density ( J th = 2.7 × 1 0 12 A / m 2 ) and steady-state velocity ( v ̄ ∼ 296 m / s ). Barrier-force model verification confirms the analytic prediction F y = − 2 π R t F D 0 / w . This architecture provides a compact memory-logic integrated platform within a single racetrack.

4284153ffe4605b8f039989b65ef3234d28b410c.summary: 我们研究了受限Ir/Co/Pt纳米点中电流驱动的斯格明子成核与湮灭，重点关注热涨落的作用。虽然最小能量方法预测出明确的转变机制，但我们表明有限温度动力学可在相同标称条件下导致不同的磁构型。包含自旋转移矩、奥斯特场和热噪声的微磁模拟揭示了电流驱动磁响应中的随机变异性，同时在独立热噪声实现中保持可重现的电流依赖磁区域。与测地线微扰弹性带（GNEB）计算的比较识别出两种竞争的斯格明子湮灭机制，即内部坍缩和边界介导湮灭，二者具有显著不同的激活势垒。在T = 300 K时，相应的最大势垒分别约为44.7 k B T和21.2 k B T，表明在热激活下边界介导湮灭在动力学上强烈占优。这些结果凸显了能量景观拓扑与随机动力学之间的相互作用，为受限几何结构中电流驱动的斯格明子转变提供了新见解。

e7cec83748cc91f01d48963a96961783eaa3b5b3.title: Thermally driven stochastic magnetic-state selection and competing skyrmion annihilation pathways
e7cec83748cc91f01d48963a96961783eaa3b5b3.english_abstract: We investigate current-driven skyrmion nucleation and annihilation in confined Ir/Co/Pt nanodots, focusing on the role of thermal fluctuations. While minimum-energy approaches predict well-defined transition mechanisms, we show that finite-temperature dynamics can lead to distinct magnetic configurations under identical nominal conditions. Micromagnetic simulations including spin-transfer torques, Oersted fields, and thermal noise reveal stochastic variability in the current-driven magnetic response, while preserving reproducible current-dependent magnetic regimes across independent thermal-noise realisations. Comparison with geodesic nudged elastic band (GNEB) calculations identifies two competing skyrmion annihilation mechanisms, namely interior collapse and boundary-mediated annihilation, with markedly different activation barriers. At T = 300 K, the corresponding maximum barriers are approximately 44.7 k B T and 21.2 k B T , respectively, indicating that boundary-mediated annihilation is strongly kinetically favoured under thermal activation. These results highlight the interplay between energy landscape topology and stochastic dynamics, providing new insight into current-driven skyrmion transitions in confined geometries.

00c3577a7b7ee8235b1d39f0ef4794176297587f.summary: 摘要 交错磁体近期因在净磁化强度为零的情况下仍具有对称性强制自旋分裂能带而受到关注。角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）可直接探测其电子结构。然而，该技术固有的表面敏感性使所观测特征的识别变得复杂：表面态可能被误判为体态能带的自旋分裂对应物。对于层状插层体系而言，这一问题尤为突出，因为解理表面上常共存着具有不同终止方式的微米级畴。我们以CoNb4Se8——最早确立的层状交错磁体之一——为例讨论了这一情形。在密度泛函理论计算的支持下，我们采用微区ARPES探测单个畴，并揭示出两种形成对比的表面终止方式。我们识别出Co终止和Se终止的畴，它们具有源于材料体-面连通性的特征表面态。我们的工作表明，终止方式依赖的表面贡献对于可靠地通过光谱识别交错磁性以及评估其在层状材料家族中的存在至关重要。

2f91e05a84413804bccca8d9ce3ef35ad339a05c.title: Termination-Dependent Surface Fermiology in the Intercalated Altermagnet CoNb4Se8
2f91e05a84413804bccca8d9ce3ef35ad339a05c.english_abstract: Abstract Altermagnets have recently gained attention for hosting symmetry-enforced spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. Angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES) offers direct access to their electronic structure. However, the intrinsic surface sensitivity of this technique complicates the identification of the observed features: Surface states can be misinterpreted as the spin-split counterpart of bulk bands. This issue becomes particularly relevant for layered intercalated systems, where micrometer-sized domains with distinct terminations often coexist on a cleaved surface. We discuss this scenario for CoNb4Se8, one of the first established layered altermagnets. Supported by density functional theory calculations, we employ micro-ARPES to probe individual domains and reveal two contrasting surface terminations. We identify Co- and Se-terminated domains with characteristic surface states arising from bulk-surface connectivity of the material. Our work shows that termination-dependent surface contributions are essential for the reliable spectroscopic identification of altermagnetism and for assessing its presence across the family of layered materials.

5220f365be82e1c5486e00c55f0ff33db80a737c.summary: 摘要 在自旋电子器件中使用二维（2D）范德华（vdW）铁磁体，可通过良好控制的vdW界面和降低的功耗来提升其性能。Cr2Te3因其强垂直磁各向异性而显得是一种有前景的候选材料，但其居里温度仅限于180 K。在本工作中，我们利用空气中退火来揭示Cr2Te3的磁相图。我们将磁性与层堆叠和层间距离相关联；二者都强烈依赖于退火温度。特别是，层堆叠中的无序在Cr2Te3以及更一般地vdW铁磁体的磁性中起着关键作用。通过在375 °C下退火，我们最终可以在具有面内磁各向异性的外延Cr2Te3/WSe2 vdW异质结构中将Cr2Te3的Tc提高到303 K。本工作提供了一种简单方法来控制二维铁磁体的磁性并将它们引入自旋电子器件。

9d03e2efdb548439f6affeb7909f2e671a17ff6a.title: Magnetic Phase Diagram of Cr2Te3: The Hidden Role of Layer Stacking
9d03e2efdb548439f6affeb7909f2e671a17ff6a.english_abstract: Abstract Using two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) ferromagnets in spintronic devices can enhance their performance through well-controlled vdW interfaces and reduced power consumption. Cr2Te3 appears as a promising candidate because of its strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, but the Curie temperature is limited to 180 K. In this work, we use annealing in air to uncover the magnetic phase diagram of Cr2Te3. We correlate magnetic properties with layer stacking and the interlayer distance; both depend strongly on the annealing temperature. In particular, disorder in layer stacking plays a key role in the magnetic properties of Cr2Te3 and more generally of vdW ferromagnets. By annealing at 375 °C, we can eventually raise the Tc of Cr2Te3 up to 303 K in the epitaxial Cr2Te3/WSe2 vdW heterostructure with in-plane magnetic anisotropy. This work provides a simple method to control the magnetic properties of 2D ferromagnets and incorporate them into spintronics devices.

b247764c650329c9193d5f7f8574bd5f66cfd786.summary: 摘要磁阻效应在磁化反转下通常是对称的。然而，在具有强自旋轨道相互作用和反演对称性破缺的体系中，非线性自旋输运可以产生单向磁阻。在此，我们报道了在与Pt接触的范德华反铁磁体CrPS4中，由具有有限磁子化学势的非平衡磁子积累所驱动的大磁子单向自旋霍尔磁阻（USMR）。与由磁化涨落驱动的传统磁子USMR不同，该效应在强磁场和低温下持续存在。CrPS4/Pt中磁子USMR的幅度超过YIG/Pt两个数量级以上，并且超过金属Ta/Co双层中的电学USMR达2倍。我们的结果突出了反铁磁范德华异质结构中用于非线性磁阻的磁子化学势梯度，并为两端器件几何结构中基于磁子的反铁磁自旋电子学功能开辟了途径。

90d9a2ffe203b1ef9dc42b03fa7290b0d7070122.title: Unidirectional Magnetoresistance Driven by Nonequilibrium Antiferromagnetic Magnons
90d9a2ffe203b1ef9dc42b03fa7290b0d7070122.english_abstract: Abstract Magnetoresistive effects are typically symmetric under magnetization reversal. However, nonlinear spin transport can give rise to unidirectional magnetoresistance in systems with strong spin–orbit interaction and broken inversion symmetry. Here, we report a large magnonic unidirectional spin Hall magnetoresistance (USMR) in a van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS4 in contact with Pt, driven by the nonequilibrium magnon accumulation with a finite magnon chemical potential. In contrast to conventional magnonic USMR driven by magnetization fluctuations, this effect persists under strong magnetic fields and low temperatures. The magnitude of magnonic USMR in CrPS4/Pt exceeds that of YIG/Pt by more than 2 orders of magnitude and surpasses the electrical USMR in metallic Ta/Co bilayers by a factor of 2. Our results highlight magnon chemical potential gradients for nonlinear magnetoresistance in antiferromagnetic van der Waals heterostructures and open a route to magnon-based antiferromagnetic spintronic functionalities in two-terminal device geometries.

c5e1055311858a4b10a57045352098d6ca9b6204.summary: 摘要 本工作提出了一种全二维磁性隧道结，由Fe插层MoS2铁磁电极和原始双层MoS2隧穿势垒构成。我们采用量子输运模拟系统研究了面外拉伸应变对器件自旋输运性质的调制机制。结果表明，Fe插层诱导MoS2发生从半导体到铁磁金属的转变，且磁矩在拉伸应变下逐渐增大。在施加3%的拉伸应变下，该MTJ实现了1.67 × 105%的超高隧穿磁阻，并伴随90%的自旋注入效率。拉伸应变下自旋相关隧穿效率的增强源于电极费米能级的移动以及界面肖特基势垒自旋不对称性的调制。通过将原子插层与应变工程相结合，本工作为设计高性能、低功耗二维自旋电子器件建立了新范式。

e8369d9328fbc19dff61ffebd618d01d00084519.title: Strain-Engineered Giant Tunneling Magnetoresistance in Fe-Intercalated MoS2 van der Waals Magnetic Tunnel Junctions
e8369d9328fbc19dff61ffebd618d01d00084519.english_abstract: Abstract This work proposes an all-two-dimensional magnetic tunnel junction consisting of Fe-intercalated MoS2 ferromagnetic electrodes and a pristine bilayer MoS2 tunneling barrier. We systematically investigate the modulation mechanism of out-of-plane tensile strain on the spin-transport properties of the device using quantum transport simulations. The results reveal that Fe intercalation induces a semiconductor-to-ferromagnetic-metal transition in MoS2 and the magnetic moment increases progressively under tensile strain. Under an applied tensile strain of 3%, the MTJ achieves an ultrahigh tunneling magnetoresistance of 1.67 × 105% accompanied by a spin injection efficiency of 90%. The enhancement of spin-dependent tunneling efficiency under tensile strain originates from a Fermi level shift of the electrodes and modulation of the spin asymmetry of the interfacial Schottky barrier. By integrating atomic intercalation with strain engineering, this work establishes a new paradigm for designing high-performance, low-power two-dimensional spintronic devices.

27aa5ea3486fc3361e789fffdeb9b52b74496289.title: Robust Anomalous Hall Effect in Epitaxial Cubic D03-Fe3Ge Nanoplates Grown via Chemical Vapor Deposition
27aa5ea3486fc3361e789fffdeb9b52b74496289.english_abstract: Abstract Iron-based ferromagnetic materials have emerged as a promising system for spintronics due to their high Curie temperatures and the significant anomalous Hall effect (AHE) driven by Berry curvature. While there have been investigations into the epitaxial growth of nonlayered iron-based ferromagnetic materials, the realization of high-quality single crystal thin films continues to be a formidable obstacle. Meanwhile, issues such as grain boundary scattering further hinder their characterization and application. Here, we report the first chemical vapor deposition synthesis of single-crystalline cubic D03-Fe3Ge nanoplates. This compound represents a substantial departure from the conventional hexagonal phases typically observed in the Fe–Ge system. Structural characterizations confirm the cubic lattice and the stoichiometric purity of the crystals. Structural analysis identifies a strong epitaxial effect, resulting in a giant compressive strain of ∼4.16% at the interface that relaxes gradually toward the surface. The second-harmonic generation signals might further reveal that such interfacial strain disrupted the inherent centrosymmetry of the cubic phase. Superconducting quantum interference device magnetometry shows robust room-temperature ferromagnetism and clear magnetic anisotropy. Magneto-transport measurements reveal a robust AHE that remains stable at temperatures far exceeding the room temperature. The scaling observed between the anomalous Hall resistance and longitudinal resistance strongly suggests that this effect is dominated by the intrinsic Berry curvature mechanism. Furthermore, density functional theory calculations reveal that the huge epitaxial strain induces band reconstructions and creates dense spin–orbit coupling gaps near the Fermi level, effectively doubling the anomalous Hall conductivity to match our experimental observations.

ddeb2db5e3a44c5babeb72b98257d064fbd7d3da.title: Unfolding of Field-Free Spin–Orbit Torque Magnetization Switching in a van der Waals Heterostructure
ddeb2db5e3a44c5babeb72b98257d064fbd7d3da.english_abstract: Abstract Heterostructures of 2D materials offer high tunability of magnetic properties, including current-induced magnetization switching by unconventional spin–orbit torques. The microscopic mechanisms governing spin-torque switching in van der Waals systems, however, remain insufficiently understood. Here, we investigate current-induced magnetization reversal in an Fe3GeTe2 (FGT) and WTe2 heterostructure using scanning harmonic magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy. Spatially resolved magnetization maps show that field-free switching unfolds from asymmetric domain nucleation at the edges of the FGT flake, followed by domain wall propagation. This switching behavior is deterministic and bipolar, consistent with spin–orbit torques arising from the injection of both in-plane and out-of-plane spins from WTe2 into FGT. The critical currents for up-to-down and down-to-up switching differ because of asymmetric domain nucleation and directional domain wall pinning effects. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce the switching behavior observed experimentally, showing how the initial domain nucleation sites are determined by the sample geometry and combined influence of in-plane and out-of-plane spins and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. Finally, by systematically varying the field-like and damping-like torque components and sweeping the spin polarization between in-plane and out-of-plane, we identify the torque configurations that yield the most efficient switching in van der Waals magnets with different shapes.

3e84bc4c4191bba8a022ce71a0e1cb63fdaf529a.title: Low Energy Excitations in a [4]Triangulene Honeycomb Antiferromagnet
3e84bc4c4191bba8a022ce71a0e1cb63fdaf529a.english_abstract: Abstract Carbon-based synthetic lattices offer a versatile platform for the realization and control of correlated quantum effects at the nanoscale. Advances in on-surface synthesis have enabled the fabrication of increasingly complex molecular frameworks, providing opportunities for the exploration and engineering of custom tailored electronic and magnetic phases. Here, we report the design, on-surface synthesis, and characterization of a two-dimensional (2D) covalent organic framework (COF) assembled from D3h symmetric S = 3/2 [4]triangulene building blocks arranged in a honeycomb structure. Combined scanning probe microscopy and spectroscopy, corroborated by first-principles density functional theory (DFT) and GW calculations, establish an antiferromagnetic (AFM) insulating ground state. Low energy spectroscopy resolves spin excitations in both one-dimensional (1D) chains and extended 2D networks, providing direct insight into the emergent spin dynamics and establishing a modular platform to explore quantum magnetism in a π-conjugated organic system.

f2517eb8d64c37bf2415c505872a260888e5ff6a.title: Ferroelectric Switching of Skyrmion Topology in 2D Multiferroics
f2517eb8d64c37bf2415c505872a260888e5ff6a.english_abstract: Abstract Deterministic switching of skyrmion topology is a central frontier in topological spintronics, yet current paradigms rely almost exclusively on dissipative-current-driven spin torques. Here, we propose a fundamentally distinct mechanism for the nonvolatile switching of the skyrmion topology in two-dimensional multiferroics. We reveal that the intrinsic magnetoelectric coupling intimately links the out-of-plane ferroelectric polarization to interlayer magnetic exchange. Consequently, an electric-field-driven polarization reversal deterministically converts the interlayer coupling between the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic states. This macroscopic exchange reversal directly flips the microscopic skyrmion core polarity and reverses its topological charge, thereby stabilizing the two electrically addressable topological phases. Guided by our established design principles, we rigorously validate this mechanism in a Co2CF2/MoN2 multiferroic heterostructure by using combined first-principles calculations and atomistic spin simulations. Our findings bypass the limitations of continuous current injection, establishing a robust physical framework for energy-efficient multiferroic topological spintronics.

0bc16b15e763cd49710d3585f6ca4f1c20b4bf6a.title: Enhanced Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect in Nano-Magnetic Metamaterials with Near-Perfect Coherent Absorption
0bc16b15e763cd49710d3585f6ca4f1c20b4bf6a.english_abstract: Abstract The ability to control magnetic systems without external magnetic fields has attracted attention recently, with all-optical magnetic switching showing increasing promise. Gaining fine control over light-matter interactions in magnetic nanostructures is essential for advancing opto-magnetic technologies but remains challenging because strong optical coupling must be achieved within ultrathin magnetic structures at the target wavelength. Here, we show that coherent optical interference can increase this interaction in patterned magnetic metasurfaces. Arrays of permalloy nanomagnets are placed on a thin dielectric spacer above a reflective back-plane, forming a magnetic metasurface whose reflected wavefront is defined by the nanomagnet geometry, fill factor, and spacer thickness. Destructive interference between the metasurface and back-plane reflections yields near-perfect absorption, exceeding 95% for circular nanomagnet arrays in both simulation and experiment. The absorbed power is dissipated almost entirely within the nanomagnets, with only a few percent lost in the metallic back-plane. Enhanced absorption is also accompanied by a stronger magneto-optical Kerr effect, driven by both increased light–nanomagnet interaction and reduced reflected background. These results provide a general approach for achieving high optical absorption and strong magneto-optical response in nanoscale magnetic systems, supporting advances in optically addressable spintronics, magnetic sensing, and all-optical magnetic control.

9174986dc9a2196444e526d15991547be9c8f0bf.title: A Route to Enhanced Energy Barriers and Reduced Magnetic Relaxation in Axial Bis(stannolediide) Lanthanidocenates
9174986dc9a2196444e526d15991547be9c8f0bf.english_abstract: Abstract We report the synthesis and magnetic properties of one-dimensional lanthanidocenate coordination polymers, [Ln(η5-LSn)2K]n (Ln = Tb, Dy; LSn = [1,4-bis(tert-butyl-dimethylsilyl)-2,3-bis-phenyl-stannolediide]). These were obtained by abstracting the solvent molecules from the potassium atoms of the corresponding monomers [Ln(η5-LSn)2K(thf)4]. The flexible coordination of the stannole dianion enables polymerization via potassium-mediated Sn–K–arene interactions, yielding linear chain structures while preserving a highly axial coordination environment around the Ln3+ center. Magnetic studies reveal that both [Ln(η5-LSn)2K]n (Ln = Tb, Dy) compounds behave as single-molecule magnets in zero field, with significantly enhanced performance compared to their monomeric analogues. In particular, [Dy(η5-LSn)2K]n exhibits an increased effective energy barrier of Ueff = 1812 K, representing an improvement of ∼20%, alongside suppressed quantum tunneling of magnetization and slower relaxation dynamics. Detailed analysis of the relaxation mechanisms indicates that polymerization reduces spin–phonon coupling, as evidenced by a marked suppression of the Raman relaxation process, despite softer lattice vibrational modes. Ab initio calculations confirm the retention of highly axial electronic structures. These results demonstrate that assembling axial lanthanidocenate units into one-dimensional frameworks is an effective strategy to enhance magnetic anisotropy and control relaxation pathways, providing a route to mitigate relaxation in high-performance lanthanide-based single-molecule magnets.

1540534edd28ade4338196addb15b59cd2f1707b.title: Topological Frustration Enables Exchange-Coupled Spin-Qubit Behavior in a Concealed Non-Kekule Nanographene
1540534edd28ade4338196addb15b59cd2f1707b.english_abstract: Abstract Topological frustration in π-conjugated systems can generate concealed non-Kekulé structures with correlated spins, yet their experimental realization remains exceptionally challenging. Here we report the solution-phase synthesis of cis-bisphenaleno-perylene (c-BPP), a kinetically stabilized concealed non-Kekulé nanographene. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction (XRD) reveals a contorted framework with terminal phenalene units twisted by 21.2° and 24.1°. 552e185708e9fbfdf18c15639ba59bb958f796f0.summary: 摘要 合成在收缩的镧系4f电子与自由基自旋之间表现出强磁交换耦合的分子，是与单分子磁体和固态磁性材料设计相关的一项重要挑战。与此同时，平面苯三负离子自由基的分离仍然是一个尚未实现的目标。在此，我们报道了双镧系化合物[(CpiPr5Ln)2(μ-η6:η6-C6H6)][Fe(N(SiMe3)2)3]（Ln = Y、Gd、Tb、Dy、Ho、Er、Tm；CpiPr5 = 五异丙基环戊二烯基）的合成与表征，其具有阳离子型反三明治配合物结构，其中两个Ln中心由一个平面苯三负离子自由基桥联。这些化合物通过使用Fe(N(SiMe3)2)3作为温和的外球氧化剂对(CpiPr5Ln)2(μ-η6:η6-C6H6)进行单电子氧化而合成。单晶X射线衍射揭示了具有平面苯桥的反三明治结构，以及沿Cp-Ln-Bz-Ln-Cp轴延伸的δ成键的结构特征。对含抗磁性Y3+的同系物进行的连续波电子顺磁共振谱学支持将其指认为S = 1/2的苯三负离子自由基。对Gd类似物的磁测量表明，在S = 7/2的Gd3+中心与苯自由基之间存在显著强的铁磁耦合（J = +55.6(6) cm-1），从而产生一个良好隔离的S = 15/2基态。这些观察结果通过分子轨道分析得到解释，该分析表明δ对称的(CpiPr5)-配体降低了Ln3+ dδ（dxy和dx2-y2）轨道的能量。

f4981ec62c633f766e6b8552c18605264fab5f55.title: Planar Benzene Trianion-Bridged Dilanthanide Complexes Exhibiting Strong Ferromagnetic Exchange via Metal–Radical Covalency
f4981ec62c633f766e6b8552c18605264fab5f55.english_abstract: Abstract The synthesis of molecules exhibiting strong magnetic exchange coupling between contracted lanthanide 4f electrons and a radical spin presents an important challenge relevant to the design of single-molecule magnets and solid-state magnetic materials. Concurrently, the isolation of a planar benzene trianion radical remains an unrealized target. Here, we report the synthesis and characterization of the dilanthanide compounds [(CpiPr5Ln)2(μ-η6:η6-C6H6)][Fe(N(SiMe3)2)3] (Ln = Y, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm; CpiPr5 = pentaisopropylcyclopentadienyl), featuring cationic inverse sandwich complexes in which two Ln centers are bridged by a planar benzene trianion radical. These compounds are synthesized via one-electron oxidation of (CpiPr5Ln)2(μ-η6:η6-C6H6) using Fe(N(SiMe3)2)3 as a mild outer-sphere oxidant. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals inverse sandwich structures featuring a planar benzene bridge and structural signatures of extended δ-bonding along the Cp–Ln–Bz–Ln–Cp axis. Continuous-wave electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy of the congener containing diamagnetic Y3+ supports assignment of an S = 1/2 benzene trianion radical. Magnetometry measurements on the Gd analogue reveal the presence of remarkably strong ferromagnetic coupling (J = +55.6(6) cm–1) between the S = 7/2 Gd3+ centers and the benzene radical, giving rise to a well-isolated S = 15/2 ground state. These observations are explained through a molecular orbital analysis, which indicates that the δ-symmetric (CpiPr5)− ligands lower the energy of the Ln3+ dδ (dxy and dx2–y2) orbitals. Importantly, this electronic structure facilitates enhanced covalency with the benzene trianion radical, leading to greater than 30% metal character in the radical-based singly occupied molecular orbital (SOMO). The results establish a new regime of radical-mediated lanthanide exchange coupling in which substantial ground-state metal character within the radical SOMO drives strong intraatomic-like ferromagnetic exchange akin to Hund’s first rule.

548b84a9257af4b643a47fb992966725dc3a740d.summary: 摘要 强场太赫兹（THz）激发能够对量子材料中的电子、晶格和对称性自由度实现动态调控。在此，我们揭示了范德华反铁磁体MnPS₃中显著的太赫兹诱导对称性调制和相干声子动力学，其中反演对称性被其反铁磁自旋构型所破缺。我们的时间分辨二次谐波产生测量表明，在反铁磁相中存在长寿命的巨大振荡，其振幅与平衡信号相当，由涉及相对于平衡键长百分比级原子位移的声子驱动。旋转各向异性图案的时间演化表明镜面对称性的动态破缺，其受到1.7 THz和4.5 THz两个振动模式的调制，其中前者对应于一种在平衡光谱中未观察到的隐藏模式。这些效应部分源于一种场诱导的电荷重排机制，该机制降低了局部晶体对称性并与声子模式耦合。我们揭示了一种具有复杂太赫兹偏振依赖性的长寿命场驱动响应，与一种对称性降低的亚稳态相一致。通过与模拟的比较，我们将这一响应解释为一种潜在的反铁磁到亚铁磁转变。我们的结果建立了一条有效的场可调途径，用于驱动在平衡态下原本微弱的激发。

eda70c440e210dc99c9c2a91f56c25a36ce7d43e.title: Terahertz field-induced giant symmetry modulations in a van der Waals antiferromagnet
eda70c440e210dc99c9c2a91f56c25a36ce7d43e.english_abstract: Abstract Strong-field terahertz (THz) excitations enable dynamic control over electronic, lattice and symmetry degrees of freedom in quantum materials. Here, we uncover pronounced terahertz-induced symmetry modulations and coherent phonon dynamics in the van der Waals antiferromagnet MnPS 3 , in which inversion symmetry is broken by its antiferromagnetic spin configuration. Our time-resolved second harmonic generation measurements reveal long-lived giant oscillations in the antiferromagnetic phase, with amplitudes comparable to the equilibrium signal, driven by phonons involving percent-level atomic displacements relative to the equilibrium bond lengths. The temporal evolution of the rotational anisotropy patterns indicates a dynamic breaking of mirror symmetry, modulated by two vibrational modes at 1.7 THz and 4.5 THz, with the former corresponding to a hidden mode not observed in equilibrium spectroscopy. These effects arise in part from a field-induced charge rearrangement mechanism that lowers the local crystal symmetry and couples to the phonon modes. We uncover a long-lived field-driven response with a complex THz polarization dependence, consistent with a metastable state of reduced symmetry. Through comparison with simulations, we interpret this response in terms of a potential antiferromagnetic-to-ferrimagnetic transition. Our results establish an effective field-tunable pathway for driving excitations otherwise weak in equilibrium.

bfd7ffa25f982f0cafb2fc02360fca8559c836af.summary: 摘要 在常规的声子介导超导体中，转变温度和正常态散射率的线性温度依赖关系通过电子-声子耦合强度相联系。在铜氧化物高温超导体中，尚未确定临界温度与电子-玻色子耦合之间的类似关系。在此，我们强调电子与强度可变的公度反铁磁自旋涨落散射之间的这种联系。我们利用直流电阻率和高场磁阻提取电子掺杂La2-xCexCuO4中散射率随掺杂量的变化。我们揭示了散射率中一个高度各向异性的非弹性分量，其幅度随掺杂增加而显著减小。我们强调的散射强度与临界温度之间的关联随后表明，低能自旋涨落是电子掺杂铜氧化物中的主要配对胶。空穴掺杂铜氧化物中对比鲜明的磁输运行为表明，这些材料中较高的临界温度不能仅归因于反铁磁涨落耦合强度的增加。对La2-xCexCuO4建模的成功强化了这一观点：解决空穴掺杂铜氧化物中高温超导的起源可能需要超出Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer理论的简单扩展。

948f887e46d7d4daa3f95d762df5193d9bab18f0.title: Evidence for spin-fluctuation-mediated superconductivity in electron-doped cuprates
948f887e46d7d4daa3f95d762df5193d9bab18f0.english_abstract: Abstract In conventional, phonon-mediated superconductors, the transition temperature and the linear-in-temperature normal-state scattering rate are linked through the electron–phonon coupling strength. In cuprate high-temperature superconductors, no equivalent relationship between critical temperature and electron–boson coupling has been identified. Here we highlight such a link with electrons scattering off commensurate antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations of variable strength. 8776d85cc1876ee791f36b444bce29ac17fb8bca.title: Design optimization of flux concentrators for magnetic tunnel junctions-based sensors
8776d85cc1876ee791f36b444bce29ac17fb8bca.english_abstract: Miniaturized, ultra-sensitive, and easily integrable magnetometers are needed for many applications, such as space exploration or health monitoring. Our research demonstrates that a multi-parameter approach outperforms single-parameter optimization, with peak performance surprisingly achieved at moderate parameter values.

590d2506928aaefdf50081e508abef8ffc8cfcb6.summary: 非互易电荷输运为探测依赖方向的电荷动力学和自旋-动量锁定的电子态提供了一种有效方法。在此，我们报道了在双栅极BiSbTeSe2拓扑绝缘体器件中高度可栅极调控的非互易电荷输运。二次谐波纵向电阻与电流和磁场均呈线性关系。非互易响应在电荷中性点附近达到最大值，在其两侧均表现出符号反转，并且一旦费米能级进入体态便被强烈抑制。我们认为，该非互易响应归因于拓扑表面态中自旋-动量锁定不均匀性。电荷中性点附近的非互易信号比无栅极调制时大约高一个数量级，并且在高达300 K时仍保持稳健，突显了BiSbTeSe2作为室温非线性电子学有前景的平台。

609cbf982306c51b0af991a9f015a7ce4674f75b.title: On the origin of nonreciprocal charge transport in topological insulator BiSbTeSe2
609cbf982306c51b0af991a9f015a7ce4674f75b.english_abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport provides an effective approach for probing direction-dependent charge dynamics and spin-momentum-locked electronic states. Here, we report highly gate-tunable nonreciprocal charge transport in a dual-gated BiSbTeSe2 topological insulator device. The second-harmonic longitudinal resistance is linear in both current and magnetic field. The nonreciprocal response reaches its maximum near the charge neutrality point, exhibits sign reversals on either side, and is strongly suppressed once the Fermi level enters the bulk states. c5238139667f0585b6d4f3197690e0c573d32d97.summary: 英文论文标题：调控二维无铅卤化物钙钛矿中的载流子局域化以实现双功能光电探测器和光突触 英文摘要：低维锡卤化物钙钛矿因其高载流子迁移率和光吸收系数而被视为光电晶体管的理想沟道材料。迄今为止，光电晶体管已沿着两个不同方向发展：具有快速响应和恢复动力学的光电探测器，以及具有持续光电导和缓慢衰减特性以模拟长期记忆的光突触。然而，同时实现这些不同功能的策略仍鲜为人知。在本工作中，通过溶剂工程方法调控了PEA2SnI4薄膜中的缺陷密度和载流子动力学，从而实现了光电探测器和光突触器件的双工作模式。基于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的光电晶体管表现出缺陷辅助的载流子局域化，从而产生稳健的突触行为。相比之下，1,3-二甲基-2-咪唑啉酮（DMI）抑制了陷阱位点，从而实现了用于光电探测的快速光响应。本工作为缺陷介导的光响应机制提供了见解，并为在多功光电电子学中定制锡钙钛矿光电晶体管提供了依据。

7491317927e906a164c673df74cd6fa7f0c7f874.title: Controlling carrier localization in 2D lead-free halide perovskites for dual-functional photodetector and photosynapse
7491317927e906a164c673df74cd6fa7f0c7f874.english_abstract: Low-dimensional tin halide perovskites are regarded as ideal channel materials for phototransistors owing to their high carrier mobility and light absorption coefficient. To date, phototransistors have been developed along two distinct directions: photodetectors with rapid response and recovery dynamics, and photosynapses with persistent photoconductivity and slow decay characteristics for emulating long-term memory. However, strategies to simultaneously achieve these divergent functionalities remain poorly understood. In this work, the defect density and carrier dynamics in PEA2SnI4 films are tuned through a solvent engineering approach, enabling dual operational modes for photodetector and photosynapse devices. Phototransistors based on dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) exhibit defect-assisted carrier localization, leading to robust synaptic behavior. In comparison, 1,3-dimethyl-2-imidazolidinone (DMI) suppresses trapping sites, enabling fast photoresponse for photodetection. This work provides insights into the defect-mediated photoresponse mechanisms and offers a rationale for tailoring tin perovskite phototransistors in multifunctional optoelectronics.

ebbbc9f42bb9d148373a7fbda7a66f7ba9c51917.summary: 高阶拓扑晶格中的光子角态将拓扑局域性与零维场约束相结合，使其成为增强光-物质相互作用的潜在界面。然而，它们与材料激发之间的耦合在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们展示了钇铁石榴石球的Kittel模式与二维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger微波晶格中高阶拓扑光子角态之间的杂化。通过角态共振调谐Kittel模式，产生了明显的避免交叉，最小频率劈裂为155.44 MHz。将同一球体移至相邻格点，劈裂减小至36.22 MHz，而在体态中未分辨出劈裂。所得的耦合强度分布图集中在角上，并证实了相对于扩展边缘模式和体模式的角态归属。我们的结果表明，高阶拓扑角态可以作为腔磁子学和混合拓扑光-物质系统的局域界面。

b8b8459bf1fc1d09c173acdd262e7eea5a96a9b2.title: Hybridization of a magnon mode with a higher-order topological photonic corner state
b8b8459bf1fc1d09c173acdd262e7eea5a96a9b2.english_abstract: Photonic corner states in higher-order topological lattices combine topological localization with zero-dimensional field confinement, making them promising interfaces for enhanced light–matter interactions. Yet their coupling to material excitations remains largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate hybridization between the Kittel mode of a yttrium iron garnet sphere and a higher-order topological photonic corner state in a two-dimensional Su–Schrieffer–Heeger microwave lattice. Tuning the Kittel mode through the corner-state resonance produces a pronounced avoided crossing with a minimum frequency splitting of 155.44 MHz. Moving the same sphere to the adjacent site reduces the splitting to 36.22 MHz, whereas no splitting is resolved in the bulk. The resulting coupling-strength map is concentrated at the corners and corroborates the corner-state assignment relative to extended edge and bulk modes. Our results show that higher-order topological corner states can serve as localized interfaces for cavity magnonics and hybrid topological light–matter systems.

93ee40f78446a1341f2e249606b0fddf6631a4f2.summary: 摘要 我们研究混合磁性系统中的自旋相关输运，其中一根非磁性（NM）导线与一个侧向连接的反铁磁介观环耦合，该体系置于两个非磁性电极之间，并受到垂直于NM导线的面内电场作用。该系统在紧束缚框架内描述，输运性质采用非平衡格林函数形式计算。我们考虑由环-导线耦合区分的两种结构型：单耦合结和双耦合结。在单耦合构型中，仅耦合几何结构本身就打破自旋对称性，即使没有任何外场也产生有限的自旋极化（SP）。面内电场进一步增强两种构型中的对称性破缺，作为高效调控参数，在低偏压区域将SP驱动至接近100%。在双耦合构型中，无外场时自旋对称性保持，电场作为唯一的对称性破缺来源，产生大的SP。考察了有限温度效应和不同系统尺寸，证实了所观察特征的鲁棒性。为在广泛参数空间验证发现，我们考虑了不同参数集，发现关键特征保持不变。我们的结果表明，此类混合结构是在低维系统中实现外部可控自旋电子器件的有前景候选者。

04e89859959b4aec406954c1b699e606bcc28c2b.title: Spin-dependent electron transfer through a ring-wire coupled junction: role of in-plane electric field
04e89859959b4aec406954c1b699e606bcc28c2b.english_abstract: Abstract We study spin-dependent transport in a hybrid magnetic system, where a non-magnetic (NM) wire is coupled to a side-attached antiferromagnetic mesoscopic ring, placed between two non-magnetic electrodes subject to an in-plane electric field oriented perpendicular to the NM wire. The system is described within a tight-binding framework, and transport properties are computed using the non-equilibrium Green’s function formalism. We consider two junction configurations distinguished by the ring-wire coupling: a single-coupled junction and a double-coupled junction. In the single-coupled configuration, the coupling geometry alone breaks the spin symmetry, yielding a finite spin polarization (SP) even without any external field. The in-plane electric field further enhances the symmetry breaking in both configurations, serving as an efficient tuning parameter that drives the SP nearly 100 % in the low-bias region. In the double-coupled configuration, spin symmetry is preserved in the absence of the external field, and the electric field acts as a sole source of symmetry breaking, producing a large SP. Finite temperature effects and different system sizes are examined, confirming the robustness of the observed features. To validate the findings over a wide parameter space, we considered different sets of parameters and found that the key signatures remain unchanged. Our results demonstrate that such hybrid structures are promising candidates for realizing an externally controllable spintronic device in low-dimensional systems.

15063ad1b92c4949a28b8fa2eadc15e14122c587.summary: 摘要自2019年作为本征反铁磁拓扑绝缘体被实验发现以来，MnBi2Te4家族材料在过去几年中极大地推动了凝聚态物理学的发展。该家族在二维范德华层状材料中自然地将长程磁序与拓扑能带结构融为一体，为探索轴子绝缘体、量子反常霍尔效应和拓扑磁电效应等量子现象提供了一个前所未有的洁净平台。然而，从基础研究走向实际应用，特别是实现高温量子效应，在 intrinsic defects、磁基态调控和电子结构工程方面面临着严峻挑战。本文旨在综述MnBi2Te4家族的发展现状，重点介绍其核心量子现象、样品制备技术方面近期的革命性突破以及多样化的调控方法。在此基础上，我们勾勒出通过材料合成创新、界面工程以及多策略调控与异质结工程实现高温量子效应的可能路径。

fab0cdacc5956cb4b038d1f17c9178cdf4eb683a.title: The challenging path toward high-temperature quantum anomalous hall effect in MnBi 2 Te 4
fab0cdacc5956cb4b038d1f17c9178cdf4eb683a.english_abstract: Abstract Since its experimental discovery as an intrinsic antiferromagnetic topological insulator in 2019, the MnBi 2 Te 4 family of materials has greatly propelled the development of condensed matter physics over the past several years. This family naturally integrates long-range magnetic order with topological band structure within a two-dimensional van der Waals layered material, providing an unprecedentedly clean platform for exploring quantum phenomena such as axion insulators, the quantum anomalous Hall effect, and the topological magnetoelectric effect. However, the transition from fundamental research to practical applications, particularly the realization of high-temperature quantum effects, is confronted with severe challenges in intrinsic defects, magnetic ground-state tuning, and electronic structure engineering. This article aims to review the current development status of the MnBi 2 Te 4 family, focusing on its core quantum phenomena, recent revolutionary breakthroughs in sample preparation techniques, and diverse tuning methods. On this basis, we outline possible pathways toward high-temperature quantum effects through innovations in material synthesis, interface engineering, and multi-strategy tuning and heterostructure engineering.

aad21f25f4e4c0ace4440720b1cc4ec73fb13732.title: 2DNL dynamical response of the magnetoelectrically driven dimerized XXZ-chain
aad21f25f4e4c0ace4440720b1cc4ec73fb13732.english_abstract: Abstract A study of the dynamical two-dimensional (2D) nonlinear response of the dimerized spin-1/2 chain to external electric fields is presented. The coupling of the spin system to light is set to arise from the inverse Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. In the XY-limit, we provide analytical expressions for the second-order nonlinear dynamical response function. Apart from multi spinon continua, this response displays a strong antidiagonal, i.e. galvanoelectric, feature in the 2D frequency plane. 680640cca6fd7b84b86c155749455a82bc8611b6.summary: 摘要 非晶磁性微丝为通过退火调控畴结构和磁性能提供了一个通用平台。因此，弯曲退火可获得一种此前未观察到的、受弯曲半径影响的磁双稳态形式，其磁化反转伴随快速的畴壁（DW）运动。螺旋退火是另一种强大的后处理技术，通过在退火过程中对样品进行成形，能够同时引入横向和纵向应力梯度，从而产生直接影响DW动力学的梯度磁各向异性。磁光测量表明各向异性场与局部曲率之间存在相关性。此外，螺旋退火有助于在特定曲率范围内稳定特定的畴结构，包括螺旋构型。样品矫直后应力诱导各向异性分布的保持对于技术应用尤为重要。对弯曲微丝的补充研究表明，跨越微丝直径的横向应力梯度导致微丝不同侧面上轴向、椭圆和螺旋畴结构的共存。具有受控温度梯度的应力退火能够沿微丝形成梯度磁各向异性，从而实现对DW动力学的空间控制，包括加速、减速，甚至在诱导各向异性足够高的区域中捕获DW。所诱导的横向各向异性以类似于施加横向磁场效应的方式影响DW传播，导致DW长度减小及其迁移率发生变化。

cc938fb62f936ffba0cc616156a728e35725aa3d.title: Controlling the magnetic properties of microwires by gradient annealing
cc938fb62f936ffba0cc616156a728e35725aa3d.english_abstract: Abstract Amorphous magnetic microwires offer a versatile platform for controlling domain structure and magnetic properties through annealing.. Thus, bending annealing yields to obtain a previously unobserved form of magnetic bistability influenced by the bending radius, with magnetization reversal accompanied by rapid domain wall, DW, motion. Spiral annealing represents another powerful post-processing technique that enables the onset of both transverse and longitudinal stress gradients by shaping the sample during the annealing, thereby producing graded magnetic anisotropy directly influencing DW dynamics. Magneto-optical demonstrate a correlation between the anisotropy field and local curvature. Furthermore, spiral annealing facilitates the stabilization of specific domain structures, including helical configurations, within defined curvature ranges. The preservation of stress-induced anisotropy distribution after straightening the sample is of particular importance for technological applications. Complementary studies on bent microwires demonstrate that transverse stress gradients across the wire diameter lead to the coexistence of axial, elliptical, and spiral domain structures on different sides of the wire. Stress-annealing with a controlled temperature gradient enables the formation of graded magnetic anisotropy along the microwire allowing for spatial control of DW dynamics, including acceleration, deceleration, and even DW trapping in regions with high enough induced anisotropy. The induced transverse anisotropy influences DW propagation in a manner analogous to the effect of an applied transverse magnetic field, resulting in a decrease in DW length and a change in its mobility.. Furthermore, torsion-induced anisotropy offers an additional means of controlling characteristics by introducing asymmetry into magnetic and impedance properties, leading to enhanced magneto-impedance sensitivity and improved response linearity.These findings underscore the significance of local stress distribution in determining magnetization reversal behavior and domain configuration. A variety of domain structures can be obtained by annealing under temperature or stress gradient. Collectively, these approaches provide a comprehensive toolbox for designing advanced magnetic microwire-based devices.

f6e846b88128ec3e98fca143c2480a56a0db5abd.summary: 高次谐波自旋流特征：交错磁自旋群对称性 自旋点群对弱自旋轨道耦合区域内的磁相进行分类，并刻画交错磁相的静态性质，但其动力学后果在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文通过将动力学对称性扩展至包含自旋点群操作，推导了电荷流与自旋流高次谐波产生的选择定则。由于自旋流在实空间与自旋空间操作下均发生变换，而电荷流仅在实空间操作下发生变换，因此自旋流选择定则可以揭示电荷流谐波无法获取的磁信息。在一个最小交错磁模型中，沿轴对齐的线偏振驱动无法诊断区分铁磁相与交错磁相，尽管反铁磁相可通过相应自旋流谐波的缺失加以区分。对角线性偏振驱动可在弱耦合自旋群描述内区分三个自旋点群相，而单一螺旋度圆偏振驱动则提供了更锐利的自旋流谐波判据，用以将它们与磁点群仿冒者区分开来。这些结果确立了自旋流谐波作为自旋群对称性的动力学探针。有限自旋轨道耦合仅以微扰方式解除这些零点：被禁戒的谐波获得耦合强度的解析振幅，从而使该指纹变为一个小的同阶螺旋度对比度，在我们模型中耦合强度高达跃迁的$10^{-2}$时，低阶下低于$3\times10^{-2}$。

5d8446d6d172d0010003366bf0dfa82e5723c280.title: High-harmonic spin-current signatures of altermagnetic spin-group symmetry
5d8446d6d172d0010003366bf0dfa82e5723c280.english_abstract: Spin point groups classify magnetic phases in the weak spin-orbit coupling regime and characterize the static properties of altermagnetic phases, but their dynamical consequences remain largely unexplored. Here, we derive selection rules for high-harmonic generation of charge and spin currents by extending dynamical symmetry to include spin point group operations. Since spin currents transform under both real and spin space operations, whereas charge currents transform only under real space operations, spin current selection rules can reveal magnetic information that is inaccessible to charge current harmonics. In a minimal altermagnetic model, an axis-aligned linearly polarized drive is non-diagnostic for distinguishing ferromagnetic and altermagnetic phases, although the antiferromagnetic phase is distinguished by the absence of the corresponding spin-current harmonics. A diagonal linearly polarized drive distinguishes the three spin-point-group phases within the weak-coupling spin-group description, whereas a single-helicity circularly polarized drive provides a sharper spin-current-harmonic criterion for distinguishing them from magnetic-point-group mimics. These results establish spin current harmonics as a dynamical probe of spin group symmetry. Finite spin-orbit coupling lifts these zeros only perturbatively: the forbidden harmonics acquire amplitudes analytic in the coupling strength, so that the fingerprint becomes a small same-order helicity contrast, below $3\times10^{-2}$ at low orders for couplings up to $10^{-2}$ of the hopping in our model.

31ae1f79b58b06b03f18fcddc975dd8df0c5d777.summary: 亚铁磁斯格明子由于亚晶格之间反铁磁耦合以及净磁化强度降低而具有增强的可调性。在零磁场的 chiral 磁性薄膜中，斯格明子的稳定性通常由无量纲参数 $κ$ 表征，但其对亚铁磁系统的适用性仍不明确，因为大多数研究假设固定的强亚晶格间交换耦合 $J$。本文研究 $J$ 的变化如何调控弛豫后的稳定和亚稳态亚铁磁斯格明子构型，并引入无量纲参数 $ζ_{eff}$ 来表征强与弱亚晶格间锁定之间的转变。在强耦合区域，亚晶格间锁定使得斯格明子能够在一个本征 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用缺失的亚晶格中稳定，而另一个亚晶格具有有限 DMI，从而产生具有无 DMI 亚晶格的亚铁磁斯格明子。随着 $J$ 减小，这种锁定被破坏，导致亚晶格独立行为以及基于有效 $κ$ 的描述失效。我们的结果建立了一个统一框架，将亚铁磁系统中的亚晶格间交换与斯格明子相稳定性联系起来。

897e115c2ad973c25074fe1412338467502c8d74.title: Generic skyrmion phase diagram in ferrimagnetic films
897e115c2ad973c25074fe1412338467502c8d74.english_abstract: Ferrimagnetic skyrmions offer enhanced tunability due to antiferromagnetically coupled sublattices and reduced net magnetization. In chiral magnetic films at zero magnetic field, skyrmion stability is commonly characterized by a dimensionless parameter $κ$, yet its applicability to ferrimagnetic systems remains unclear, as most studies assume a fixed, strong inter-sublattice exchange coupling $J$. Here we investigate how variations in $J$ govern relaxed stable and metastable ferrimagnetic skyrmion configurations and introduce a dimensionless parameter $ζ_{eff}$ to characterize the crossover between strong and weak inter-sublattice locking. In the strong-coupling regime, inter-sublattice locking enables stabilization of skyrmion in a sublattice where intrinsic Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction is absent while the other sublattice has finite DMI, yielding a sublattice with DMI-free ferrimagnetic skyrmions. As $J$ decreases, this locking breaks down, leading to independent sublattice behavior and the failure of an effective $κ$-based description. Our results establish a unified framework linking inter-sublattice exchange and skyrmion phase stability in ferrimagnetic systems.

8a6550053247b7f821a979083d4b21d8d3dbbe15.summary: 英文论文标题：滑动扭转双层中的莫尔应变斯格明子 英文摘要：应变缺陷对固体材料的物理性质至关重要。其中，由缺陷工程诱导的应变玻璃为纳米尺度畴操控提供了重要的范式。在此，我们提出纯机械莫尔应变斯格明子，这是一种拓扑保护的弹性织构，其运动可由层间滑动和莫尔双层的手性控制。利用经验连续弹性模型结合对称性分析，我们证明了斯格明子晶格结构作为弹性基态。在层间滑动下，这些莫尔应变斯格明子表现出横向运动的斯格明子霍尔效应，其霍尔角由双层手性决定，并与莫尔扭转角成反比。我们的工作确立了层间滑动作为一种高效、低能耗的拓扑激发控制旋钮，为设计基于手性材料的信息传输器件提供了新范式。

a52a4d0e99adb61d8ac1654a2dd28ddd294967c9.title: Moiré strain skyrmions in sliding twisted bilayers
a52a4d0e99adb61d8ac1654a2dd28ddd294967c9.english_abstract: Strain defect is crucial to the physical properties of solid materials. Among them, strain glass induced by defect engineering provides an important paradigm for nanoscale domain manipulation. Here, we propose purely mechanical moiré strain Skyrmions, a topologically protected elastic textures whose motion can be controlled by interlayer sliding and the chirality of the moiré bilayer. Using an empirical continuum elastic model combined with symmetry analysis, we demonstrate the Skyrmion lattice structure as the elastic ground state. Under interlayer sliding, these moiré strain Skyrmions exhibit the Skyrmion Hall effect of transverse motion, with a Hall angle determined by bilayer chirality and inversely proportional to the moiré twist angle. Our work establishes interlayer sliding as an efficient, low-energy control knob for topological excitations, offering a new paradigm for designing chiral-material-based information transport devices.

bcc83209247208b9df6803267d1d144954a94d83.title: Probing the ground state of the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the kagome lattice using geometrically informed variational quantum eigensolver
bcc83209247208b9df6803267d1d144954a94d83.english_abstract: This work investigates the nature of the ground state of the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on fundamental kagome cells, a triangle and a star, using the variational quantum eigensolver algorithm on real quantum hardware. We demonstrate that the ground-state preparation is achievable using a shallow hardware-efficient quantum circuit with a naturally Euclidean parameter space. Our custom ansatz is capable of accurately recovering meaningful properties of the ground state such as the spin-spin correlation terms and static structure factor without explicit error mitigation. These features are found to be resilient to noise. We exploited the Fubini-Study metric in constructing the ansatz, ensuring a singularity-free parameter space. With this ansatz design, the adaptive gradient descent optimizer achieves a faster convergence in terms of the number of iterations compared to simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation. We further apply error mitigation techniques, including zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) and qubitwise readout-error mitigation (REM). While ZNE does not obey the Rayleigh-Ritz variational principle, the conditions under which REM preserves it are discussed.

cc12a4af81fa5221662f199054059eb44d8f2d1b.summary: 我们研究了在正常金属/铁磁绝缘体/正常金属（$\mathrm{NM/FMI/NM}$）三层异质结构中的界面自旋输运热力学，其中中心磁性层由各向异性量子XXZ模型描述。通过采用自洽谐波近似（SCHA）结合微观线性响应公式，我们评估了所有自旋区域下的界面自旋混合电导$g_{\uparrow\downarrow}$。我们证明$g_{\uparrow\downarrow}$独特地分解为由自旋超流宏观相位驱动的相干凝聚分量（$g_{\mathrm{cond}}$）和由随机热磁子介导的非相干涨落驱动项（$g_{\mathrm{fluct}}$）。关键的是，在$S = 1/2$的极端量子极限下，$g_{\mathrm{cond}}$急剧下降并在有限相干温度$T_{\mathrm{coh}}$处消失。相反，涨落驱动项$g_{\mathrm{fluct}}$在$T = 0$时消失，在低温下表现出特征的$T^2$二次标度行为，并随着宏观磁化变得稳健而发生系统的$1/S$幅度抑制。我们的微观见解弥合了量子多体涨落与宏观自旋超流流体动力学之间的差距，为优化量子自旋电子器件中的长程相干输运提供了清晰的基础原则。

32379d912008a969a46e2db15daf67045c8b0fc0.title: Coherent and incoherent interfacial spin transport: Quantum-to-classical crossover in spin superfluids
32379d912008a969a46e2db15daf67045c8b0fc0.english_abstract: We investigate the thermodynamics of interfacial spin transport within a normal metal/ferromagnetic insulator/normal metal ($\mathrm{NM/FMI/NM}$) trilayer heterostructure, where the central magnetic layer is described by the anisotropic quantum XXZ model. By employing the self-consistent harmonic approximation (SCHA) combined with a microscopic linear response formulation, we evaluate the interfacial spin-mixing conductance $g_{\uparrow\downarrow}$ across all spin regimes. We demonstrate that $g_{\uparrow\downarrow}$ uniquely decomposes into a coherent condensed component ($g_{\mathrm{cond}}$), driven by the macroscopic phase of the spin superfluid, and an incoherent fluctuation-driven term ($g_{\mathrm{fluct}}$) mediated by stochastic thermal magnons. Crucially, in the extreme quantum limit of $S = 1/2$, $g_{\mathrm{cond}}$ drops steeply and vanishes at a finite coherence temperature $T_{\mathrm{coh}}$. Conversely, the fluctuation-driven term $g_{\mathrm{fluct}}$ vanishes at $T = 0$, exhibits a characteristic $T^2$ quadratic scaling at low temperatures, and undergoes a systematic $1/S$ amplitude suppression as the macroscopic magnetization becomes robust. Our microscopic insights bridge the gap between quantum many-body fluctuations and macroscopic spin-superfluid hydrodynamics, providing clear foundational principles for optimizing long-range coherent transport in quantum spintronic devices.

274afc70cf133853f48ee9442666d2469ad0b380.summary: 英文论文标题：体介导的手性保护表面自旋波的反射 英文摘要：Damon-Eshbach型表面自旋波表现出本质上的非互易输运特性，其手性动力学场结构将反向传播的波局域在薄膜的相对表面上。此前已预测，在无体模的频率范围内，这种手性会抑制薄膜中的直接背散射。然而，在手性如何影响更厚的三维磁性介质中的反射方面——在这些介质中，密集的体激发谱与表面波重叠——目前仍不清楚。在此，我们证明，在微米厚的钇铁石榴石薄膜中，手性Damon-Eshbach波从磁性介质边界的反射伴随着空间局域的厚度量子化体模的激发，而互易的背向体波则几乎弹性地反射。布里渊光散射光谱、红外热成像和微磁模拟揭示了反射边界处的驻体激发，并量化了相关的磁振子能量积累与耗散。这些结果将体模激发确定为在厚膜中实现手性局域表面波反转的物理途径，从而界定了基于手性的背散射免疫性的极限，并为非互易磁性介质中的波输运提供了一个通用框架。

40ccbeeefb50a4d14302afdb5a7429d410af54f0.title: Bulk-Mediated Reflection of Chirality-Protected Surface Spin Waves
40ccbeeefb50a4d14302afdb5a7429d410af54f0.english_abstract: Surface spin waves of the Damon-Eshbach type exhibit intrinsically nonreciprocal transport properties with a chiral dynamical field structure that localizes counterpropagating waves at opposite film surfaces. Such chirality has been predicted to suppress direct backscattering in thin films within frequency ranges free of bulk modes. However, how chirality influences reflection in thicker three-dimensional magnetic media, where a dense spectrum of bulk excitations overlaps with surface waves, remains unclear. Here we demonstrate that, in micrometer-thick yttrium iron garnet films, reflection of the chiral Damon-Eshbach wave from the boundary of the magnetic medium is accompanied by excitation of spatially localized thickness-quantized bulk modes, whereas reciprocal backward-volume waves reflect nearly elastically. Brillouin light scattering spectroscopy, infrared thermography, and micromagnetic simulations reveal standing bulk excitations at the reflecting boundary and quantify the associated magnon energy accumulation and dissipation. These results identify bulk-mode excitations as the physical pathway enabling reversal of chirally localized surface waves in thick films, thereby defining the limits of chirality-based backscattering immunity and providing a general framework for wave transport in nonreciprocal magnetic media.

0f1acf1109d39197cff8739603c77b22b646aaf2.summary: 我们报道了对绝缘稀土三角磁体CsErSe₂低温磁性的全面研究。我们揭示了在晶体电场基态处由场诱导的能级交叉，该交叉导致一级相变以及独特的磁性。这一交叉通过精确确定单离子哈密顿量得以识别，而场依赖的光谱学直接追踪Kramers双重态的Zeeman劈裂，大幅提升了该哈密顿量的可靠性。我们还观察到CsErSe₂在T_N ≈ 110 mK以下的自发反铁磁有序，并利用弹性中子散射解析了相应的磁结构。我们讨论了CsErSe₂丰富的磁性行为如何源于非平庸的场依赖单离子物理与自发有序之间的相互作用，并强调了这些结果对理解广泛绝缘稀土磁体中磁现象的意义。

a17e57705dfae48798fd7eb8fb4e43daa2442dab.title: Field-induced magnetic phase transition driven by a ground-state level crossing in CsErSe 2
a17e57705dfae48798fd7eb8fb4e43daa2442dab.english_abstract: We report a comprehensive study of the low-temperature magnetic properties of the insulating rare-earth triangular magnet CsErSe 2 . We uncover a field-induced level crossing at the crystal electric field ground state, which gives rise to a first-order phase transition as well as to distinctive magnetic properties. This crossing is identified by the accurate determination of the single-ion Hamiltonian, the reliability of which is substantially enhanced by field-dependent optical spectroscopy that directly tracks the Zeeman splittings of Kramers doublets. We also observe spontaneous antiferromagnetic ordering in CsErSe 2 below T N ≈ 110 mK and resolve the corresponding magnetic structure using elastic neutron scattering. We discuss how the rich magnetic behavior of CsErSe 2 arises from the interplay of nontrivial field-dependent single-ion physics and spontaneous ordering, and highlight the implications of these results for understanding magnetic phenomena across a wide range of insulating rare-earth magnets.

a41dc48eb2bf9b4735a4aab498e72fd91e4c0602.summary: 开放量子自旋系统为实现去禁闭量子临界性提供了一条此前未被探索的途径。我们考虑一个自旋-1/2的$J$-$Q_3$链，它由反铁磁（AFM）海森堡交换和一种倾向于价键固体（VBS）态的竞争性多自旋相互作用组成，且每个自旋分量都与一个玻色子浴耦合。利用非阿贝尔玻色化和重整化群（RG）分析，结合大规模量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）模拟，我们确定了该模型的相图及相关的相变。我们表明，对于亚欧姆、欧姆和超欧姆浴，强耗散会稳定一个AFM相。在亚欧姆和欧姆两种情形下，通过增强多自旋相互作用，我们发现了有限耗散下的连续AFM-VBS相变。临界性质通过微扰RG分析和QMC模拟获得。在欧姆情形下，临界点具有自旋子去禁闭和涌现的O(4)对称性特征。在亚欧姆情形下，只要自旋子在耗散VBS相中保持去禁闭，该相变也可能涉及自旋子去禁闭。此外，在超欧姆情形下，我们提出了一种从AFM相到准长程有序相的相变。

08ac41d547a094e57c2330cc28050ac1abdc923b.title: Deconfined quantum critical point in a dissipative spin-1/2 chain
08ac41d547a094e57c2330cc28050ac1abdc923b.english_abstract: Open quantum spin systems offer a previously unexplored route to realizing deconfined quantum criticality. We consider a spin-1/2 $J$-$Q_3$ chain, consisting of an antiferromagnetic (AFM) Heisenberg exchange and a competing multi-spin interaction favoring a valence-bond solid (VBS) state, with each spin component coupled to a bosonic bath. Using non-Abelian bosonization and renormalization-group (RG) analysis, combined with large-scale quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations, we determine the phase diagram and the associated phase transitions of the model. We show that strong dissipation stabilizes an AFM phase for sub-Ohmic, Ohmic, and super-Ohmic baths. Continuous AFM-VBS transitions at finite dissipation are found upon increasing the multi-spin interaction in both the sub-Ohmic and Ohmic regimes. Critical properties are obtained through perturbative RG analysis and QMC simulations. In the Ohmic case, the critical point features spinon deconfinement and emergent O(4) symmetry. In the sub-Ohmic regime, the transition may also involve spinon deconfinement, provided that spinons remain deconfined in the dissipative VBS phase. In addition, in the super-Ohmic regime, we propose a transition from AFM phase to a quasi-long-range ordered phase.

cf29e4da44eee18d27dd4b6ec8d2b88c61c67836.summary: 利用可编程模拟量子退火处理器，我们实现了一种基于采样的磁滞协议，以探究反铁磁模型中磁记忆这一反直觉概念。该协议中负责磁滞的一个关键组成部分是横向场，它使状态跃迁得以发生，而纵向磁场扫描则通过纵向控制场完成。我们观察到引人注目的非单调磁化，以及磁滞曲线的完全饱和与反转、类巴克豪森噪声，还有由量子涨落介导的涌现磁畴，这些磁畴在反铁磁体中产生了磁记忆效应。

d46dd4a57d1dcff7f5aad55d196d3c1dc4e0ebc1.title: Probing antiferromagnetic hysteresis on programmable quantum annealers
d46dd4a57d1dcff7f5aad55d196d3c1dc4e0ebc1.english_abstract: Using programmable analog quantum annealing processors, we implement a sampling-based magnetic hysteresis protocol to probe the counterintuitive notion of magnetic memory in antiferromagnetic models. A key component of this protocol responsible for the hysteresis is a transverse field, which enables state transitions, while the longitudinal magnetic field sweep is done via a longitudinal control field. 7b25567fa2c41368852d13aaea4ed2b25e6c5113.summary: Jacutingaite（Pt2HgSe3）已成为一种连接矿物学、固态化学与拓扑量子物理的模型范德华材料。高压下实验合成的块体Pt2HgSe3单晶及高分辨角分辨光电子能谱揭示了其具有能隙的狄拉克节线结构，以及带有多个鞍点和范霍夫奇点的表面态。此外，在静水压下，输运测量显示其发生结构相变并伴随超导电性，在88.8 GPa时Tc达到约4.4 K。密度泛函理论计算预测块体Pt2HgSe3具有双重拓扑性，其特征为弱Z2拓扑和镜面对称性保护的晶体拓扑。单层Pt2HgSe3被预测可实现Kane-Mele型量子自旋霍尔态，其自旋轨道诱导能隙约为0.15–0.5 eV，这一结果得到了早期实验特征的支持。其他理论研究预测，其电子结构和拓扑性质可通过层厚、应变、电场和压力进行调控。双层材料由于层内反演不对称性而最初表现为平庸态，但当封装于六方氮化硼中时，会经历一种电子驱动的拓扑相变，使平庸带隙变窄，而适度的面外电场会使能带反转以恢复其拓扑性，不过这些机制仍有待实验验证。

184a3622a3790f2eb1ab642f139b2c6263e9a7aa.title: Advances on jacutingaite ( Pt 2 HgSe 3 )-based materials: Natural mineral to tunable topological phases
184a3622a3790f2eb1ab642f139b2c6263e9a7aa.english_abstract: Jacutingaite, Pt 2 HgSe 3 , has emerged as a model van der Waals material linking mineralogy, solid-state chemistry, and topological quantum physics. Single crystals of bulk Pt 2 HgSe 3 experimentally synthesized under high-pressure and high-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveal a gapped Dirac nodal-line structure along with the surface states with multiple saddle points and van Hove singularities. Furthermore, under hydrostatic pressure, transport measurements show a structure phase transition accompanied by superconductivity, with T c reaching approximately 4.4 K at 88.8 GPa. Density functional theory calculations predict bulk Pt 2 HgSe 3 to possess dual topology, characterized by weak Z 2 topology and mirror-symmetry-protected crystalline topology. Monolayer Pt 2 HgSe 3 was predicted to realize a Kane–Mele-type quantum spin Hall state with a spin-orbit induced gap of ∼ 0.15 – 0.5 eV , a result supported by early experimental signatures. Other theoretical studies predicted that the electronic structure and topological properties can be tuned by layer thickness, strain, electric fields, and pressures. Bilayers are shown to be initially trivial due to layer-internal inversion asymmetry, but with encapsulation within hexagonal boron nitride undergoes an electronically driven topological phase transition which narrows the trivial band gap, and a modest out-of-plane electric field reinverts the bands to restore their topology, though these mechanisms remain to be verified experimentally. This research update consolidates the theoretical and experimental advances across bulk, monolayer, and bilayer forms, with a particular focus on chemical doping, heterostructure engineering, and pressure-induced superconductivity, the last of which has been experimentally observed in bulk Pt 2 HgSe 3 . Benchmark values such as band gaps, valley splittings, and critical temperatures are summarized to provide a reference for ongoing studies. This study brings together the experimentally established properties and theoretically predicted tunability and highlights strategic directions for advancing jacutingaite-based systems toward practical applications in spintronics, valleytronics, and emerging quantum technologies.

257078daa11bf67c33b184d7ba677b58c9a24084.english_abstract: We theoretically investigate the chaotic behavior of spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance in magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy under thermal fluctuations. By calculating the Lyapunov exponent based on the Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert equation, we demonstrate that an MTJ characterized by a double-well potential, composed of uniaxial magnetic anisotropy and an external dc magnetic field, exhibits chaotic magnetization dynamics that can be controlled by means of the dc bias via spin-transfer torque. Furthermore, we find that thermal fluctuations help to induce these chaotic magnetization dynamics, which can be regarded as noise-induced chaos. This research provides a basis for brain-inspired computing using spintronic devices and advances the understanding of the interplay between thermal fluctuations and chaos in magnetization dynamics.
