adf8c85638d164a51c980051c8d2215ca7d2775c.title: Optical vortex generation by magnons with spin-orbit-coupled light
adf8c85638d164a51c980051c8d2215ca7d2775c.english_abstract: Light possesses both spin and orbital angular momentum. In spatially inhomogeneous optical fields, which are characterized by a finite distribution of wave vectors in k space, these properties undergo spontaneous coupling, referred to as optical spin-orbit coupling. The study of the coupling has recently become central in modern optics due to its substantial applications in communications, sensing, and quantum control. A key challenge is to clarify the relationship between the origins of spatially inhomogeneous optical fields and the resulting spin-orbit coupling. Current research focuses on materials and configurations exhibiting spatial inhomogeneity, such as focusing lenses, interfaces, inhomogeneous media, and metasurfaces. However, Maxwell’s equations indicate that matter can introduce both spatial inhomogeneity and temporal asymmetry into optical fields. For instance, magnetic ordering breaks the time-reversal symmetry of interacting optical fields via the magneto-optic effect, introducing nonreciprocity in the resulting optical phenomena. Despite the importance, optical phenomena involving both spatially inhomogeneous and temporally asymmetric optical fields remain unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that combining temporal asymmetry and spatial inhomogeneity through magnons and light focusing, respectively, transforms an input Gaussian beam into a specific optical vortex beam in a nonreciprocal manner. This phenomenon is quantitatively explained by integrating the physics of magnon-induced Brillouin light scattering with optical spin-orbit coupling. The observed conservation of total angular momentum, encompassing both magnons and photons, further indicates that magnons can control both spin and orbital angular momentum of light. Finally, we outline future research directions enabled by optical fields exhibiting both spatial inhomogeneity and temporal asymmetry.

2329a77ff4f184062a48ece0a163694aec727c84.summary: 交错磁体尽管净磁化强度为零，却具有自旋劈裂的电子能带，这为超越传统铁磁体的自旋电子学开辟了新途径。超越基于对称性的分类——这类分类只指明允许的项而不给出其层级——本文利用第一性原理计算和Wannier哈密顿量工程，揭示了$g$波交错磁体Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$中交错磁自旋劈裂的微观成键贡献。我们表明，该劈裂可由短程紧束缚模型描述，从而确立其局域起源。通过选择性地控制跃迁通道，我们证明主要贡献并非来自磁性离子之间的直接跃迁，而是来自配体介导的杂化，后者将各向异性传递至巡游态。这确定配体辅助耦合为交错磁自旋劈裂的关键机制，并在最小模型与对称性引导的第一性原理材料搜索之间提供了微观桥梁，从而使交错磁功能性的实空间设计成为可能。

597f1ca43a3c4fb216072e8cb4045ac2a8663806.title: Ligand-mediated origin of altermagnetic spin splitting
597f1ca43a3c4fb216072e8cb4045ac2a8663806.english_abstract: Altermagnets host spin-split electronic bands despite zero net magnetization, opening new routes for spintronics beyond conventional ferromagnets. Going beyond symmetry-based classifications, which specify allowed terms but not their hierarchy, here we use first-principles calculations and Wannier Hamiltonian engineering to uncover the microscopic bonding contributions of altermagnetic spin splitting in the $g$-wave altermagnet Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$. We show that the splitting is captured by a short-range tight-binding model, establishing its local origin. By selectively controlling hopping channels, we demonstrate that the dominant contribution arises not from direct magnetic-ion hopping, but from ligand-mediated hybridization that transfers anisotropy to itinerant states. This identifies ligand-assisted coupling as the key mechanism of altermagnetic spin splitting and provides a microscopic bridge between minimal models and symmetry guided first-principles material searches, enabling real-space design of altermagnetic functionality.

29dae26629ed21a499176247eecf8ed80c875cac.title: Skyrmion and meron phases induced by spin-phonon coupling
29dae26629ed21a499176247eecf8ed80c875cac.english_abstract: In chiral magnets, magnetic skyrmions are typically stabilized by the competition between exchange and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions under an external magnetic field, while the role of lattice degrees of freedom has received comparatively less attention. Here we study how spin-phonon (SP) coupling modifies magnetic interactions and the resulting spin textures in a two-dimensional skyrmion model in the square lattice. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we compare two simplified models describing the SP coupling: the Einstein site-phonon (ESP) and bond-phonon (BP) models. Integrating the lattice degrees of freedom, we obtain effective Hamiltonians for each SP model, which involve three-spin interactions and quadratic terms. In both cases, skyrmion crystals are stabilized in field regimes that are topologically trivial in the uncoupled model. Moreover, in certain regimes, the conventional triple-$\qv$ hexagonal skyrmion lattice is distorted into a double-$\qv$ square skyrmion lattice. Additionally, we find that, in the ESP model, strong phonon coupling affecting the exchange interactions drives the system from typical low-field helical phases to meron-antimeron crystals with no net chirality. Overall, our results show that lattice effects provide a simple mechanism to tune a wide variety of topological magnetic phases, ranging from typical skyrmion crystals to distorted arrangements of skyrmions, elongated bimerons and meron-antimeron phases.

714b2037fa63ea100d4d72ee80bc6159eafc62e5.title: Magnetic quadrupole current generation and accumulation in noncentrosymmetric systems
714b2037fa63ea100d4d72ee80bc6159eafc62e5.english_abstract: Magnetization control via magnetic octupole injection has recently been proposed for a new class of centrosymmetric antiferromagnets, namely $d$-wave altermagnets, where the magnetic octupole is the lowest-rank magnetic multipole allowed by symmetry and serves as an alternative carrier to spin injection. In contrast, in noncentrosymmetric antiferromagnets, the magnetic quadrupole (MQ) constitutes the lowest-rank symmetry-allowed magnetic multipole, suggesting that MQ currents can provide an efficient route toward magnetization control through MQ injection. Here, we establish the symmetry conditions for MQ-current generation by constructing the multipole representation of the MQ conductivity tensor and show that MQ currents are generically allowed in noncentrosymmetric crystallographic point groups. As a representative example, we demonstrate MQ-current generation in the linear-response regime associated with symmetry lowering from the centrosymmetric point group ($mmm$) to its noncentrosymmetric subgroup ($mm2$). Furthermore, we reveal MQ accumulation near sample edges, analogous to spin accumulation induced by the spin Hall effect. This edge accumulation provides direct evidence of MQ-current generation and constitutes a key prerequisite for realizing MQ injection and MQ-based magnetization control in noncentrosymmetric antiferromagnets.

f129642129c768bec81da57d3e21613fd75d3794.summary: 英文论文标题：RuO2中的反常声子选择定则与拉曼光学活性 英文摘要：拉曼光谱中选择定则的破缺与光学活性的出现，通常标志着对理解固体新相至关重要的对称性破缺事件。在此，我们将近期发展的旋转各向异性拉曼光谱技术应用于单晶二氧化钌——这是一种近期备受关注的化合物，被视为交错磁性的候选主力材料，但其磁基态仍处于激烈争论之中。我们的数据揭示了区中心声子选择定则的显著破缺，并伴随着两个相反螺旋度不守恒的圆偏振散射通道在角度依赖偏振测量图中出现明显分裂。这些观测为先前被忽视的对称性破缺事件提供了确凿证据，该事件涉及空间对称性或时间反演对称性。无论哪种情形，其 underlying 机制很可能是体隐藏序参量，可能涉及由局域晶体场环境所设定的钌(IV)的多极矩。我们的工作表明，微妙的对称性破缺事件如何能够通过晶格动力学显现，并呼吁重新开展实验与理论努力，以绘制二氧化钌这一处于量子相变边界附近的体系的相图。

bded459d240ae8763554a91772ded96c66ffc9da.title: Anomalous phonon selection rules and Raman optical activity in RuO 2
bded459d240ae8763554a91772ded96c66ffc9da.english_abstract: Breakdown of selection rules and emergence of optical activity in Raman spectroscopy typically signal symmetry-breaking events essential for understanding novel phases of solids. Here, we apply our recently developed rotational anisotropy Raman spectroscopy technique to single-crystal ruthenium dioxide—a compound of recent interest as a candidate workhorse material for altermagnetism yet whose magnetic ground state remains under intense debate. Our data reveal a salient breakdown of selection rules for zone-center phonons, accompanied by clear splitting in the angle-dependent polarimetry plots for the two opposite helicity-nonconserving circularly polarized scattering channels. These observations provide definitive evidence of a previously overlooked symmetry-breaking event, involving either spatial or time-reversal symmetry. In either scenario, the underlying mechanism is likely a bulk hidden order parameter, potentially involving multipole moments of Ruthenium(IV) set by the local crystal field environment. Our work demonstrates how subtle symmetry-breaking events can manifest through lattice dynamics and calls for renewed experimental and theoretical efforts to map the phase diagram of ruthenium dioxide as a system poised near quantum phase transition boundaries.

9b993b4b4e4e4dd7cccf70e0e4103519067b5bab.summary: 将纯自旋电流注入超导体仍然是超导自旋电子学中的一大挑战。以往研究主要集中于自旋极化准粒子和自旋三重态超电流，而涡旋——第二类超导体中普遍存在的拓扑缺陷——在理论上被提出可作为自旋角动量的替代载体，但仍缺乏直接的实验证据。在此，我们报道了在NbSe2/LiAl2Fe3O8（LAFO）双层结构（一种伊辛超导体/亚铁磁绝缘体异质结构）中由涡旋介导的自旋电流注入。在面外温度梯度和面内磁场下，NbSe2/LAFO双层在上临界磁场附近表现出显著的热电峰，其符号与在单层NbSe2中观察到的常规涡旋能斯特信号相反。符号反转表明，由自旋电流注入诱导的涡旋流与由温度梯度驱动的涡旋流方向相反，这与包括自旋-涡度嬗变和逆涡旋自旋霍尔效应在内的理论机制一致。通过绘制场-温度相图，我们揭示自旋电流注入仅发生在NbSe2的涡旋液态中。在超导转变温度以上不存在热电信号，进一步排除了准粒子的贡献。我们的结果确立了涡旋作为超导体中自旋信息的有效载体，为涡旋介导的超导自旋电子器件开辟了一条新途径。

30e1c5ee97a32c683d95f35ed55b05b8ce53c6cc.title: Vortex-mediated spin current injection into two-dimensional superconductor NbSe 2
30e1c5ee97a32c683d95f35ed55b05b8ce53c6cc.english_abstract: Injection of pure spin current into superconductors remains a major challenge in superconducting spintronics. Previous studies have primarily focused on spin-polarized quasiparticles and spin-triplet supercurrents, while vortices—ubiquitous topological defects in type-II superconductors—have been theoretically proposed as alternative carriers of spin angular momentum, yet direct experimental evidence is still lacking. Here, we report the vortex-mediated spin current injection in NbSe 2 /LiAl 2 Fe 3 O 8 (LAFO) bilayer, an Ising superconductor/ferrimagnetic insulator heterostructure. Under an out-of-plane temperature gradient and an in-plane magnetic field, the NbSe 2 /LAFO bilayer shows a pronounced thermoelectric peak near the upper critical magnetic field, which has the opposite sign to the conventional vortex Nernst signal observed in a single-layer NbSe 2 . The sign reversal suggests that the vortex flow induced by spin current injection is opposite to the flow driven by the temperature gradient, which is consistent with theoretical mechanisms including spin-vorticity transmutation and the inverse vortex spin Hall effect. By mapping the field–temperature phase diagram, we reveal that the spin current injection occurs exclusively in the vortex liquid phase of NbSe 2 . Absence of the thermoelectric signal above the superconducting transition temperature further rules out the quasiparticle contribution. Our results establish vortices as efficient carriers of spin information in superconductors, opening a new route towards vortex-mediated superconducting spintronic devices.

e0640b61a67c7c4da68dadd004da0eb25c578d0c.summary: 在量子磁性中，在承载不同激发（玻色型磁振子与费米型自旋子）的相之间实现连续相变，是一个长期寻求的现象，类似于量子色动力学中的禁闭-去禁闭转变。我们报道了在三角晶格反铁磁体二硫化铥镱中这种转变的证据。反铁磁序在T_N ≈ 0.53开尔文以下发展。c轴磁场抑制这一序，将系统驱动到无能隙量子自旋液体，其自旋子费米面在μ_0H_c ≈ 3特斯拉以上，由热导率中有限的剩余线性项、类泡利磁化率和与温度无关的核磁共振奈特位移所证明。从上方接近H_c时， itinerant激发的散射率强烈增强，而它们的态密度没有显示出临界增强，这不同于常规磁量子临界性。这些结果指向一个由超越金兹堡-朗道范式的分数化激发所支配的连续禁闭-去禁闭转变。

9b4b3c3baf7183f24cb8c74b797cb16c554009b1.title: A continuous confinement-deconfinement transition in a triangular quantum magnet
9b4b3c3baf7183f24cb8c74b797cb16c554009b1.english_abstract: A continuous transition between phases hosting distinct excitations—bosonic magnons versus fermionic spinons—is a long-sought phenomenon in quantum magnetism, analogous to the confinement-deconfinement transition in quantum chromodynamics. We report evidence for such a transition in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet thallium ytterbium disulfide. Antiferromagnetic order develops below T N ≈ 0.53 kelvin. A c -axis field suppresses this order, driving the system into a gapless quantum spin liquid with a spinon Fermi surface above μ 0 H c ≈ 3 T , evidenced by a finite residual linear term in thermal conductivity, a Pauli-like susceptibility, and a temperature-independent nuclear magnetic resonance Knight shift. Approaching H c from above, the scattering rate of itinerant excitations is strongly enhanced, while their density of states shows no critical enhancement, atypical of conventional magnetic quantum criticality. These results point to a continuous confinement-deconfinement transition governed by fractionalized excitations beyond the Ginzburg-Landau paradigm.

e392db2c428673095bf3aa26da4807d230692d26.summary: 生物炭复合材料因其可再生性和低成本而在电磁波吸收方面具有前景，但性能优化仍是一项挑战。在此，空心CoFe/CoFe2O4复合纳米颗粒（其中CoFe相与CoFe2O4相共存）通过热处理过程中的Kirkendall型过程，在荷叶衍生的多孔碳上原位生长。优化后的复合材料（在800 °C下热解）表现出69.20 emu/g的饱和磁化强度和482 Oe的矫顽力；在2.70 mm的匹配厚度下计算得到最小反射损耗（RLmin）为-71.4 dB，在1.70 mm处有效吸收带宽（EAB）为5.68 GHz，覆盖了Ku波段的大部分。增强的微波吸收性能归因于介电损耗与磁损耗的协同作用、极化弛豫以及改善的阻抗匹配，连同空心结构内的多次散射。此外，FeCo与CoFe2O4之间的交换耦合可能有助于磁耗散，而空腔可能促进内部反射以进一步衰减能量。这项工作为高性能生物炭基吸收剂提供了一条生物质衍生路线，使其可与合成对应物相竞争。

f3263a6c6402a9bdb33c975ada7a2868b7ac3731.title: Boosting Microwave Absorption via Hollow CoFe/CoFe2O4 Nanoparticles Anchored on Lotus-Leaf-Derived Biochar
f3263a6c6402a9bdb33c975ada7a2868b7ac3731.english_abstract: Biochar composites are promising for electromagnetic wave absorption due to their renewability and low cost, but performance optimization remains a challenge. Here, hollow CoFe/CoFe2O4 composite nanoparticles, in which the CoFe and CoFe2O4 phases coexist, are grown in situ on lotus-leaf-derived porous carbon via a Kirkendall-type process during heat treatment. The optimized composite (pyrolyzed at 800 °C) exhibits a saturation magnetization of 69.20 emu/g and a coercivity of 482 Oe; a calculated minimum reflection loss (RLmin) of −71.4 dB is obtained at a matching thickness of 2.70 mm, with an effective absorption bandwidth (EAB) of 5.68 GHz at 1.70 mm, covering most of the Ku band. The enhanced microwave absorption performance is attributed to the synergy of dielectric and magnetic losses, polarization relaxations, and improved impedance matching, together with multiple scattering within the hollow structure. In addition, the exchange coupling between the FeCo and CoFe2O4 may contribute to magnetic dissipation, while hollow cavities may promote internal reflections for further energy attenuation. This work provides a biomass-derived route to high-performance biochar-based absorbers competitive with synthetic counterparts.

22d40a036c66844d15e693ee65fc87431c5e39af.summary: 摘要 本文综述了用于在硅平台上实现超低功耗电子-光子-自旋半导体系统的IV族半导体物理与技术。首先，在Si上异质外延Ge、SiGe和GeSn合金的基础上，介绍了一些用于高速CMOS和硅光子器件的技术。接着，以集成逻辑与非易失性存储器为目标，利用Si上的Ge说明了用于自旋晶体管的电学自旋注入与检测技术。同时，介绍了Ge中自旋弛豫时间和自旋扩散长度等自旋相关物理性质研究的最新进展。与此同时，将介绍低温形成的栅堆叠结构、绝缘体上Ge（GOI）结构以及Ge/SiGe多异质结构的最新研究进展，以将CMOS技术与自旋电子和/或自旋光子器件结合在Si平台上。最后，将针对未来应用描述自旋隧道FET、垂直自旋FET、Si平台上基于GeSn的自旋器件的可能性。

54cf29bb26459246d31067f2718a93900262ea0d.title: Group-IV semiconductor physics and technologies for next-generation electron-photon-spin integrated devices on silicon
54cf29bb26459246d31067f2718a93900262ea0d.english_abstract: Abstract This paper reviews group-IV semiconductor physics and technologies for realizing ultra-low-power electron-photon-spin semiconductor systems on a silicon platform. First, some technologies for high-speed CMOS and silicon photonics devices are introduced on the basis of heteroepitaxy of Ge, SiGe, and GeSn alloys on Si. Next, aiming to integrate logic and nonvolatile memory, electrical spin injection and detection technologies for spin transistors are explained using Ge on Si. 8b0dd1021c7077bec79a5d9ce494a1522eaed2b6.title: Optically Tunable Chiral Magnetic States and Exchange Engineering via Charge‐Transfer Excitation in a van der Waals Antiferromagnet CrPS 4
8b0dd1021c7077bec79a5d9ce494a1522eaed2b6.english_abstract: ABSTRACT Controlling magnetism with light in two‐dimensional van der Waals magnets could enable ultrafast, energy‐efficient spintronics. However, selectively writing distinct magnetic phases, such as chiral magnetic states (e.g., spin spirals and skyrmions) for memory and collinear states for logic, within a single material remains an outstanding challenge. Here, we demonstrate deterministic, photon‐energy‐selective writing of magnetic order in the air‐stable antiferromagnet chromium thiophosphate (). Its ligand‐to‐metal charge transfer gap serves as an intrinsic switching threshold: excitation below this gap drives – transitions to stabilize chiral magnetic states due to a spin–spiral phase, while excitation above activates a photo‐doping mechanism that renormalizes magnetic exchange and induces a collinear phase. These optically defined states are distinguished through polarization‐resolved magneto‐optical spectroscopy and probed via a proximal monolayer tungsten diselenide (). By establishing optical selectivity in a single material, our work provides a reconfigurable platform for opto‐spintronic circuits where memory and logic functions can be dynamically toggled with light.

a64e46a0ae31988c9d6cea1c32b048a5e9a4f16c.english_abstract: Magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) study in the past three decades, resulting in over 25,000 publications while adding 1000 more each year, has become among the most persuasive areas of research. MTJ devices lead the ubiquitous success of spintronics for technological advancement from most aspects of information technology to health sciences, with unprecedented, all-encompassing benefits to the society. We navigate through the evolution of the developing field of MTJs and the related technologies, with continued efforts for improving the tunnel magnetoresistance ratio. The MTJs' excellent ability to convert spin signals to charge signals secures their extensive commercial applications in magnetic data storage and field sensing. More advanced implementation and progress such as with neuromorphic and probabilistic computing entail from here.

7394d1cf9ce44c8273ec7899e70304abf58ffe7c.title: Ultrafast Mimic of Spin Hall Effect in Altermagnets
7394d1cf9ce44c8273ec7899e70304abf58ffe7c.english_abstract: Abstract The spin Hall effect, a key effect in creating spin currents and controlling magnetic order at the nanoscale, presupposes a population of mobile carriers in a conducting state, in which a driving charge current generates a perpendicular spin-current. Here we show an ultrafast light-wave driven spin Hall analogue exists in altermagnetic semiconductors and insulators, in which a laser pulse generates both a charge current and a co-occurring perpendicular pure spin current. Employing the example of the theoretically predicted 2d altermagnetic Lieb-lattice semiconductor Cr2SO, we demonstrate that pulse design allows lightwave control over the postpulse spin/charge current ratio ξres, with values exceeding unity obtained in the multicycle regime. Our findings thus both considerably broaden the materials base for spin Hall/spin splitter physics, as well as establishing 2d altermagnets as a platform providing a new route for valleytronic lightwave control of spin- and charge currents at ultrafast times.
